```text
14	# DS Bot + Squad 第一批核心实验 EXP-01～EXP-04 计划（2026-10-29）
15	
16	> 状态：**计划草案，未开跑，未提交**。第 8 节的决策点等 kms9 拍板后才进入开发。
17	>
18	> **依据**：
19	> - `docs/prd/pi-squad-team实验需求.md` §三（负对照）、§五（B0/B1/B2 基线）、§六（P1～P6）、§八（EXP-01～04）、§九（指标）；
20	> - `docs/prd/pi-squad-team验收指标.md`：TeamBench 的角色分离与「Verifier 误批」、CooperBench 的失败分类、AgentWorld 的 CCE、评测分层 E4 Judges；
21	> - 现有 runner `dsh_squad/experiments/run.mjs`；
22	> - `docs/dsh-squad-验证与实验总结-2026-10-28.md` §8（对照实验）、§19（未验证项）。
23	>
24	> **范围**：PRD §十 的等成本、等时间两种预算**这次不做**。Token、调用次数、用时只记录，不作为判定依据。
25	
26	## 0. 先说结论
27	
28	- **四个实验共用一套底座**：
29	  - 每次运行用全新项目目录；
30	  - 所有组都跑在 DS Bot + Squad 里，用同一模型、同一工具集、同一产物存储；
31	  - 最终成果交给仓库外的确定性判题脚本打分，LLM 只做辅助的教学评分和问题归类。
32	- **为什么所有组都放进 Squad**：单智能体组不走 DS Bot 自由模式。自由模式有 bash 和写文件，正式任务只读（O7，P5 = A），两边工具不对等。自由模式也没有结束信号和产物版本，上次 S/A 组的「成功」只表示「有回复」（总结 §8）。
33	- **需要新开发的**：
34	  - 通用部分：runner v2、确定性判题框架、给所有组同样使用的页面取证工具、不调用 LLM 的固定编排 Leader、人工介入和机器挂起的自动计数；
35	  - EXP-03：审核链（Reviewer → Auditor），以及 bug 植入与计分；
36	  - EXP-04：Run 时限、成果「当前版本」的 CAS、动态认领池。
37	- **工作量和耗时**：开发约 23 人日；真实模型运行的机器时间约 16～20 小时（估算，见 §7）。
38	- **运行前置**：T 阶段的真实模型结果都在 DS Bot `e13bc34` 上。v0.2.0 上只跑过 O6（总结 §19-3）。所以开跑前要先在 v0.2.0 上做一次真实模型冒烟。
39	
40	---
41	
42	## 1. 共同设计
43	
44	### 1.1 组怎么映射到 DS Bot + Squad
45	
46	| PRD 组 | 在我们系统里的形态 | 现有能力 | 要新开发 |
47	|---|---|---|---|
48	| **B0 强单智能体** | 一个只有一名成员的小队，工作流只有一步 `execute`，验收 `on_completion`。这名成员在一个 attempt 内可以多次调用取证工具、自己修改，然后一次提交 | 小队与工作流配置、`on_completion`（对照实验 B 组已用）、产物存储 | 固定编排 Leader（不调 LLM）；取证工具 |
49	| **B1 单智能体 + SOP** | 同一个 Bot，工作流四步 `plan → execute → check → fix`，四步都是同一个 role，验收 `on_completion` | 工作流依赖、`refs` 引用上一步结果 | 同上。另外**要先核实**：同一 role 连续几个任务是否在同一个 DSH 会话里，上下文能否延续（D0） |
50	| **P1 三角色 DAG** | 设计 → 实现 → 检查，三个 role 三个 Bot；检查不通过就返工 | 工作流 DAG、审核与返工（M2，T 阶段真实模型已验证） | 固定编排 Leader |
51	| **Single Agent（EXP-02）** | 同 B0 | 同上 | 同上 |
52	| **固定 DAG Team（EXP-02）** | 六步六个 role，与 PRD 的流水线一一对应 | 同 P1 | 同上；「浏览器测试」一步要用取证工具 |
53	| **Self Review（EXP-03）** | 一个 Bot，`execute → self_check`。`self_check` 是同一 role 的 `execute`；Controller 禁止 `SELF_REVIEW`，所以不能用 `review` 类型 | 同 B1 | 同上 |
54	| **Executor + Reviewer** | 现有 `acceptance_policy.mode = review`，退回后自动返工 | 已有（数学课件真实模型已验证） | 固定编排 Leader 的自动返工 |
55	| **Executor + Reviewer + Auditor** | Reviewer 通过后由 Auditor 独立复核，两者都通过才验收；Auditor 退回同样触发返工 | 现在只支持一个 `reviewer_ref` | **审核链** `reviewer_refs: [reviewer, auditor]` |
56	| **中央 Planner（EXP-04）** | 现有 LLM Leader。限制它只在开局决定一次（一次性拆成 DAG），之后只能 `wait`/`complete` | LLM Leader、`squad_decide` | `plan_once` 策略；Run 时限；成果当前版本 CAS |
57	| **动态认领池（EXP-04）** | 没有 Leader 拆分。三名 worker 空闲时由 Controller 自动给一个「发现」任务：看当前版本和池子 → 加入新工作项或认领一项 → 认领的工作项变成该 worker 的执行任务 → 交出新版本（带 base hash）→ 再次空闲 | 任务、attempt、子任务 | **认领池**：工作项表、原子认领（CAS + 租约）、发现任务、`squad_pool_*` 工具；Run 时限；当前版本 CAS |
58	
59	**为什么默认用固定编排 Leader**：
60	- 现在每个小队都有一个 LLM Leader（`scheduler/leader.go`），会额外走很多步。真实数学课件一次 Run 里有 12 次 Leader 决定（ACCEPTANCE「T 阶段结果」）。
61	- 对 B0/B1/P1、Single/固定 DAG、EXP-03 三组来说，分解是人工固定的。LLM Leader 会引入和被测变量无关的成本和随机性（它可能自己加任务）。
62	- 只有 EXP-04 的「中央 Planner」组，分解本身就是被测变量，所以保留 LLM Leader。
63	
64	### 1.2 工具对等与取证工具
65	
66	- **现状**：
67	  - 正式任务只读，允许 `read/grep/find/ls`（`cases/math/.../team.json`），成果经 `squad_submit_result` 交给产物存储；
68	  - 没有浏览器工具：DS Bot 的 `read_browser` 只在桌面版有（`ds-bot/src/host/browser.js`），而桌面版不支持（P4）；
69	  - 所以现在的「检查员」只能读代码。
70	- **计划**：新增一个所有组、所有 role 都能用的只读工具 `squad_check_page(artifact, viewport)`。它在宿主上用无头 Chrome 打开已提交或草稿的 HTML，返回：
71	  - 控制台错误、外部请求；
72	  - 375 px 和 1280 px 下的横向溢出、可见文本摘要；
73	  - 基础无障碍检查（控件是否有可访问名称）。
74	- **防泄题**：这个工具**不执行判题脚本里的检查项**，判题用例只在仓库外运行（§1.4）。它给的是「环境证据」，PRD §六 P3 要求 Reviewer 基于证据说话，这个工具就是提供证据的手段。
75	- 单智能体组和多角色组用同一个工具，工具差异就不会成为混杂变量。
76	
77	### 1.3 隔离与输入
78	
79	- 沿用 runner 的做法：每组每次一个全新项目目录（`dsh_squad/experiments/.runs/<exp>-<arm>-<n>`），新的 Bot、新的记忆、新的 Controller 数据（D12）。
80	- 输入素材（EXP-03/04 的课件）复制进项目目录的 `input/`。
81	- **判题用例、bug 清单、优化机会清单**放在 `dsh_squad/experiments/fixtures/<exp>/hidden/`。这个目录不在任何项目目录里。受控任务的文件工具只能访问项目、Bot 工作目录和 DS Bot 工作区，`..` 和软链接会先解析（`ee2bc6e`），所以读不到它。开跑前用一个负例确认：让 Bot 去读 hidden 路径，应当被拒。
82	- 每组的任务说明逐字相同，只有工作流配置不同。说明里写明「验收接口约定」：判题要用的 `data-testid`、文件名 `lesson.html`、单文件、不得引用外部资源。这样判题能自动化，各组面对的要求也完全一样。
83	
84	### 1.4 判定方法（优先级：确定性脚本 > 环境检查 > LLM）
85	
86	| 层 | 内容 | 用在哪 |
87	|---|---|---|
88	| **Script Judge** | 无头 Chrome（puppeteer-core，沿用 `probes/ui-*.mjs` 的用法，不进仓库）加载最终 `lesson.html`，执行交互用例、做数学校验（按公式比对页面显示的数值和 SVG 采样点）、检测 bug 是否仍在 | 全部实验的 Goal Success、需求覆盖率、缺陷逃逸率 |
89	| **Environment Judge** | 控制台错误、外部请求、375 px 横向溢出、键盘可达、可访问名称（可选 axe-core，见 §8 决策 11） | 全部实验 |
90	| **LLM Judge** | 盲评：去掉组名、随机顺序，只给成果文件和量表。用途：教学量表 1～5 分；EXP-03 把审核意见对应到 bug 编号（同时提供 bug 清单）；EXP-04 两两比较。用与执行不同的模型（§8 决策 7），每份成果评 2 次取平均，差 ≥ 2 分时人工复核 | 只单独报告，**不进 Goal Success** |
91	| **Trace Judge** | 从 Controller 事件和 DSH 会话日志自动统计：返工、交接、验收退回、认领冲突、STALE_BASE、超时、人工操作、机器挂起 | 失败归因、协调指标 |
92	
93	判题脚本每个用例跑 3 次，3 次结果不一致就记为「判题不稳定」并修判题，不计入结果。
94	
95	**指标定义**：
96	
97	| 指标 | 定义 |
98	|---|---|
99	| **Goal Success**（每次运行，0/1） | 有最终成果，且所有「必须」级确定性用例通过，且无控制台错误、无外部请求。EXP-03 还要求缺陷逃逸率 ≤ 1/12 且没有新引入的回归。EXP-04 要求无回归且至少实现 k 个优化机会（k 见 §5.4） |
100	| **需求覆盖率** | 通过的需求检查数 ÷ 需求检查总数。每条需求至少对应一条确定性检查；只能由 LLM 评的要求单独列出 |
101	| **缺陷逃逸率**（EXP-03） | 最终成果里探测脚本仍然失败的植入 bug 数 ÷ 植入 bug 数（12）。按组汇总所有 bug × 运行 |
102	| **检出率 / 修复率**（EXP-03） | 审核或自查意见里提到的 bug ÷ 12（LLM 对应，人工抽查）；探测脚本由失败转为通过的 bug ÷ 12 |
103	| **误报率**（EXP-03） | 指出的问题中，既不是植入 bug、也不是真实缺陷的比例；另统计 2 个诱饵被指为 bug 的次数 |
104	| **Verifier 误批率** | 系统内验收判「通过」、但 Goal Success = 0 的运行 ÷ 系统内验收通过的运行（对应 TeamBench 的 49% 现象） |
105	| **回归数** | 输入课件上原本通过、最终成果上失败的基线用例数（EXP-03/04） |
106	| **稳定性** | 同组重复运行的 Goal Success 比例 |
107	| **Useful Work Ratio**（EXP-04） | 改动进入最终版本的工作项 ÷ 执行过的工作项（借 AgentWorld CCE 的思路） |
108	| **重复工作率 / 冲突**（EXP-04） | 内容重复的工作项比例（LLM 归类、人工抽查）；STALE_BASE 被拒次数 |
109	| 只记录 | Token（含辅助调用）、模型调用数、墙钟时间、交接与返工次数、人工介入、并行度 |
110	
111	### 1.5 重复次数
112	
113	| 实验 | 建议 | 理由 |
114	|---|---|---|
115	| EXP-01 | 每组 5 次 | 单页任务便宜（上次真实 B 组 275～323 秒）。5 次时成功率的分辨率是 20%，足以看出「多 Agent 明显更差或差不多」这类负对照结论 |
116	| EXP-02 | 每组 5 次 | 第一核心实验，但多角色组一次可能 20～45 分钟（估算）。5 次是成本和结论稳定性的折中 |
117	| EXP-03 | 每组 5 次 | 每次有 12 个 bug，按 bug × 运行算每组有 60 个观察，缺陷逃逸率的估计比按运行算的成功率稳定得多 |
118	| EXP-04 | 每组 3 次 | 每次固定 30 分钟，加准备和判题约 40 分钟。开放任务方差大，3 次只能给方向性结论，结论里写明 |
119	
120	- 样本小，**不报 p 值**。报告每次运行的明细、中位数和范围。只有两组差距超过组内范围时，才写「X 优于 Y」，否则写「无可分辨差异」。
121	- 组的执行顺序按轮次交错（第一轮 A1 B1 C1，第二轮 A2 B2 C2……），避免 API 状态或机器状态随时间漂移，系统性地偏向某一组。
122	
123	### 1.6 结果报告格式
124	
125	- runner 输出 `dsh-squad-experiment/2` JSON（在 `/1` 上扩展），外加一份 Markdown 汇总。
126	- 每次运行记录：
127	  - 标识：`exp_id`、`arm`、`repeat`、`order`；
128	  - 版本：`project`、`versions`（dsh、ds-bot sha、补丁哈希、controller/adapter sha）；
129	  - 运行：`model`（provider/model/effort，取自会话日志）、`started`/`ended`、`suspended_seconds`、`outcome`；
130	  - 成果与判题：`final_artifact`（sha256、来自哪个任务）、`checks[]`（id、级别、结果、3 次是否一致）、`metrics`、`llm_judge`（分数、评审模型）；
131	  - 归因与记录：`failure`（类别、证据、判定方式：自动或人工）、`human_actions[]`、`tokens`、`trace`。
132	- 证据（时间线、会话日志、截图、成果文件）按 AGENTS.md 留在本机，不入库。是否提交汇总见 §8 决策 8。
133	
134	### 1.7 失败归因分类
135	
136	每个 Goal Success = 0 的运行都要给出主因（可附次因）。能从事件自动判的自动判，其余由人看 trace 判，并写明判定方式。
137	
138	| 类别 | 判据（自动的部分） |
139	|---|---|
140	| Spec Misread 需求误读 | 成果做的是别的东西，或明显漏掉需求（人工判） |
141	| Quality Failure 质量失败 | 交付了，但确定性用例失败；系统内也没有人指出 |
142	| Work Decomposition Error 分解错误 | 中央 Planner 的任务清单漏掉了关键工作，或拆出互相冲突的任务 |
143	| Dependency Error 依赖错误 | 下游用了旧版本（`STALE_INPUT`），或等待一个永远不会完成的依赖 |
144	| Claim Conflict 认领冲突 | 两个 worker 做同一件事，或认领后被抢 |
145	| Communication Failure 通信失败 | 审核意见没有传到返工任务，或返工没有回应意见 |
146	| Commitment Failure 承诺失败 | 认领了不交付，或说「已完成」却没有结果 |
147	| Artifact Integration Failure 集成失败 | `STALE_BASE` 后丢改动，最终版本缺了已验收的改动 |
148	| Acceptance Failure 验收失败 | 审核放过了确定性用例失败的成果（误批），或退回了合格成果导致超时 |
149	| Runtime Failure 运行时失败 | 超时、API 错误、宿主或 Controller 崩溃 |
150	| Environment Interruption 环境中断 | 机器挂起（`suspended_seconds > 0`）。**不计入结果，重跑** |
151	
152	---
153	
154	## 2. EXP-01｜单页互动模块（负对照）
155	
156	### 2.1 问题与假设
157	
158	- **问题**：需求清楚、规模小的单页任务，多 Agent 是否其实没有价值？多 Agent 如果赢了，是不是只因为它被强制用了更好的流程？
159	- **对应假设**：
160	  - **H2 协调成本**：预期 P1 不优于 B0、B1，协调成本更高；
161	  - **H5 工作分解**：小任务上预期无收益；
162	  - B1 用来区分「流程收益」和「多 Agent 收益」（PRD §五）。
163	- **预期**：B0 ≈ B1 ≥ P1。如果 P1 显著更好，就要检查 P1 是否只是多了一轮检查。
164	
165	### 2.2 任务（真实题目）
166	
167	> 为初三学生做一页可交互讲解页面 `lesson.html`，讲二次函数 y = ax² + bx + c 的图像与性质，以 y = x² − 2x − 3 为例。
168	
169	| 编号 | 需求 | 级别 | 确定性检查 |
170	|---|---|---|---|
171	| R1 | 坐标系带刻度，x ∈ [−4, 6]，画出函数图像 | 必须 | 读取 `data-testid=curve` 的 SVG path 采样点，按坐标轴映射回数学坐标，与 f(x) 比较，误差 < 2% 量程 |
172	| R2 | 三个滑块 `a`、`b`、`c`（a ∈ [−3, 3] 且 a ≠ 0，b、c ∈ [−6, 6]），图像实时更新 | 必须 | 随机 10 组参数，设置后重测 R1 |
173	| R3 | 显示顶点坐标、对称轴、与 x 轴交点；Δ < 0 时显示「无实数根」 | 必须 | 10 组参数（含 Δ < 0、Δ = 0）下，读 `vertex`、`axis`、`roots` 的文本并与公式比对（±0.01） |
174	| R4 | 讲解：配方求顶点、求根公式、开口方向与 a 的关系 | 必须 | 页面文本包含三个小节（`data-testid=explain-*`）；内容正确性交给 LLM 量表 |
175	| R5 | 练习：给一组新参数，学生输入顶点坐标，点「提交」后给出对错反馈（容差 ±0.01） | 必须 | 输入正确值、错误值、带空格的正确值、「1.0」形式，检查反馈 |
176	| R6 | 单文件，不引用任何外部资源 | 必须 | 网络请求为 0 |
177	| R7 | 375 px 宽时不横向滚动，控件可点 | 应当 | `scrollWidth ≤ 375`；控件在视口内 |
178	| R8 | 控件有可访问名称，可用键盘操作，反馈不只靠颜色 | 应当 | 可访问名称检查；Tab 能到达；反馈有文字 |
179	
180	教学量表（LLM，单独报告）：讲解准确、由浅入深、例题与练习匹配、文字适合初三、互动服务于理解，共 5 项，每项 1～5 分。
181	
182	### 2.3 各组配置
183	
184	| 组 | 配置 | Bot 数 |
185	|---|---|---|
186	| **B0** | 1 名成员「课件作者」，一步 `execute`：「按需求完成 lesson.html，可用 squad_check_page 自查，然后提交」；`on_completion` | 1 |
187	| **B1** | 同一成员四步：`plan`（写设计与需求对照表）→ `execute`（实现）→ `check`（用取证工具逐条对照需求，列出问题）→ `fix`（修复并提交最终版）；`on_completion`；最终成果取 `fix` 的结果 | 1 |
188	| **P1** | 三个 role：`designer`（交互与讲解设计、需求对照表）→ `builder`（实现）→ `checker`（逐条对照取证）。checker 作为 `review` 验收 builder 的结果，退回就自动返工，最多 3 次 | 3 |
189	
190	同一模型、同一取证工具、同一时限（30 分钟）；固定编排 Leader，不调 LLM。
191	
192	### 2.4 判定
193	
194	- Goal Success：R1～R6 全部通过，且无控制台错误。
195	- 需求覆盖率：R1～R8 的检查通过比例。
196	- 另记：教学量表、B1/P1 的「检查发现问题数」。
197	
198	---
199	
200	## 3. EXP-02｜复杂互动实验（第一核心实验）
201	
202	### 3.1 问题与假设
203	
204	- **问题**：知识、设计、代码、验证都要做的完整互动实验，固定 DAG 专业分工是否优于单智能体？
205	- **对应假设**：
206	  - **H5 工作分解**（主）：明确的依赖图是否减少遗漏，提高需求覆盖率；
207	  - **H4 异质性**（次）：角色分工带来不同的信息通道（学科审校、浏览器取证）；
208	  - **H7 工作契约**（次）：每一步有明确的预期输出和验收，是否减少伪完成。
209	- 建议加第三组 B1（§8 决策 9）：区分「DAG 收益」和「SOP 收益」。
210	
211	### 3.2 任务（真实题目）
212	
213	> 为高一物理做一个互动实验页面 `lesson.html`：**探究单摆周期与摆长的关系**。
214	
215	| 编号 | 需求 | 级别 | 确定性检查 |
216	|---|---|---|---|
217	| R1 | 教学目标与实验原理（小角度时 T = 2π√(L/g)），写明适用条件（摆角 ≤ 10°） | 必须 | 文本存在（`data-testid=goal`、`principle`）；公式正确性由数学检查读取页面暴露的 `T(L)` 显示 |
218	| R2 | 单摆动画：摆长 L（0.2～2.0 m）、初始摆角 θ（2°～30°）可调；有开始、暂停、重置 | 必须 | 状态机用例：开始 → 暂停 → 继续时角度连续；重置后回到初始状态；运行中改 L，按需求规定的行为处理 |
219	| R3 | 动画物理正确：小角度时周期误差 < 3% | 必须 | 读取页面暴露的 `window.lessonState()`（接口约定）中的角度时间序列，测过零周期，与 2π√(L/g) 比较；L 取 0.25、1.0、1.96 |
220	| R4 | 计时测量：学生点「测 10 个周期」，结果记入数据表（L、10T、T） | 必须 | 模拟点击 3 次（3 个 L），表格行数、数值与 R3 一致（±3%） |
221	| R5 | 画 T–√L 图并给出拟合斜率，与 2π/√g 比较 | 必须 | 读取图上的点和斜率文本，与表格和理论值比较（±5%） |
222	| R6 | 大摆角提示：θ > 10° 时提示近似失效 | 应当 | θ = 25° 时出现提示 |
223	| R7 | 3 道小测：选择题与数值题，判对错并给解释 | 必须 | 正确、错误、边界输入的判题 |
224	| R8 | 单文件、无外部资源、无控制台错误 | 必须 | 同 EXP-01 |
225	| R9 | 375 px 可用 | 应当 | 同 EXP-01 R7 |
226	| R10 | 可访问名称、键盘可操作、动画可暂停 | 应当 | 同 EXP-01 R8 |
227	
228	**备选题**（§8 决策 3）：数学「抛硬币与大数定律」。同样有模拟、数据表、图和小测，物理部分换成频率收敛的统计检查。
229	
230	### 3.3 各组配置
231	
232	| 组 | 配置 |
233	|---|---|
234	| **Single Agent（B0）** | 1 名成员，一步 `execute`，任务说明与需求表逐字相同；可用取证工具；`on_completion` |
235	| **固定 DAG Team** | 六步六个 role，与 PRD 流水线对应：<br>① `goal`（教学目标、学情、需求对照）<br>② `physics`（学科正确性：公式、适用条件、数值范围、测量方法，产出「学科规格」）<br>③ `ux`（交互设计：控件、状态机、布局，产出「交互规格」）<br>④ `builder`（实现，`refs` 引用 ②③）<br>⑤ `tester`（用取证工具逐条对照规格测试，产出问题清单；以 `review` 验收 ④，退回就返工）<br>⑥ `pedagogy`（教学质量验收，对 ⑤ 通过后的版本做 `review`）<br>依赖：①→②、①→③、②③→④、④→⑤→⑥。②③ 可以并行 |
236	| （建议）**B1** | 同 EXP-01 的 B1，四步 |
237	
238	时限 60 分钟（估算：上次真实 C 组 141 次调用 674 秒时仍未完成）。
239	
240	**要新开发**：
241	- 审核链：⑤ 和 ⑥ 都要对 ④ 做验收，和 EXP-03 共用；或者 ⑥ 审核 ⑤ 通过后的版本，用现有单 reviewer 加依赖实现。
242	- 取证工具。
243	- 固定编排 Leader。
244	
245	### 3.4 判定
246	
247	- Goal Success：R1～R5、R7、R8 全部通过。
248	- 需求覆盖率：R1～R10。
249	- 另记：教学量表；各步的返工次数；`physics` 规格与最终实现的一致性（R3、R5 是否通过）。
250

252	
253	## 4. EXP-03｜独立验收（隐藏 bug）
254	
255	### 4.1 问题与假设
256	
257	- **问题**：独立 Reviewer 和 Auditor 是否显著降低缺陷逃逸？
258	- **对应假设**：
259	  - **H3 独立验证收益**（主）；
260	  - **H4**（次）：Auditor 与 Reviewer 职责不同（取证核对 vs 通读审查），是否带来新的有效信息通道；
261	  - 同时测 **Verifier 误批率**。
262	
263	### 4.2 任务与 bug 清单
264	
265	**输入**：我们自己手写一份正确的「金标」课件 `golden/lesson.html`（二次函数，满足 EXP-01 的 R1～R8 与接口约定，确定性用例全部通过），再用植入脚本注入 12 个 bug，得到 `input/lesson.html`。
266	
267	**给 Agent 的任务**（三组逐字相同，不提 bug）：
268	
269	> 这是准备上线的二次函数课件 `input/lesson.html`。请增加一道「已知顶点和一点求解析式」的练习（需求同 R5 的判题规则），并交付可以上线的版本。上线标准：数学正确、图像正确、动画与交互正确、判题正确、手机上可用、可访问。
270	
271	**植入的 bug**（每类 2 个，共 12 个；默认参数下尽量不显露）：
272	
273	| ID | 类别 | bug | 植入方式（相对金标） | 探测脚本（bug 在时失败） |
274	|---|---|---|---|---|
275	| B01 | 公式 | 顶点横坐标符号错：`-b/(2a)` 写成 `b/(2a)` | 改 `vertexX()` 一处符号；默认例题 b = −2 时页面数值仍「看起来合理」 | b = 4、a = 1 时读取 `vertex`，应为 (−2, …) |
276	| B02 | 公式 | 求根公式分母 `2*a` 写成 `2` | 改 `roots()`；a = 1 时不显露 | a = 2、b = −4、c = −6 时 roots 应为 3、−1 |
277	| B03 | SVG 坐标边界 | 曲线采样循环 `x < xMax` 少一步，右端最后一段缺失 | 改循环边界 | path 采样最右点的 x 应 ≥ xMax − 一个步长 |
278	| B04 | SVG 坐标边界 | 顶点超出视窗时标记和文字画到 SVG 外（缺少裁剪或钳制） | 删除 `clamp()` 调用 | c = 6、a = 1 时 `vertex-point` 的坐标应在 viewBox 内或带「超出」提示 |
279	| B05 | 动画状态 | 「演示开口变化」动画暂停后再播放会从头开始 | 暂停时不保存进度 | 播放 1 秒 → 暂停 → 播放，a 值应连续 |
280	| B06 | 动画状态 | 动画进行中拖动滑块，动画结束时把滑块值覆盖回动画终值 | 动画结束回调无条件写 a | 播放中设 a = 2，结束后 a 应仍为 2（或动画被中止） |
281	| B07 | 判题 | 用字符串比较判对：「1.0」「 1」判错 | `===` 比较原始字符串 | 输入「1.0」「 1 」应判对 |
282	| B08 | 判题 | 只比较 x 坐标，y 坐标填什么都判对 | 删掉 y 的比较 | x 对、y 错应判错 |
283	| B09 | 移动端布局 | SVG 固定 `width=600` 且无 viewBox 缩放 | 改属性 | 375 px 下 `scrollWidth ≤ 375` |
284	| B10 | 移动端布局 | 控件区 `flex-wrap: nowrap` + `min-width`，按钮在 375 px 下被截断 | 改 CSS 两处 | 375 px 下「提交」完整可见且可点 |
285	| B11 | 无障碍 | 三个滑块没有 label 或 `aria-label` | 删 `<label for>` | 每个滑块有可访问名称 |
286	| B12 | 无障碍 | 判题反馈只用红绿色，没有文字，反馈区也没有 `aria-live` | 改反馈渲染 | 反馈区有文字结果且 `aria-live` 存在 |
287	
288	**诱饵**（2 处，测误报）：
289	- D1：用 `x*x` 而不是 `Math.pow(x, 2)`；
290	- D2：一条写着 `// TODO` 的注释，但功能已经实现。
291	
292	**植入方式**：
293	- `fixtures/exp-03/inject.mjs` 对金标逐个应用替换（每个 bug 是一段「原文 → 改后」），生成 `input/lesson.html` 和隐藏清单 `hidden/bugs.json`（ID、类别、位置、探测用例）。
294	- 每个 bug 单独植入时，只让自己的探测用例失败，其他基线用例照常通过（植入脚本自检）。
295	- 12 个 bug 全部植入后，新需求之外的基线用例仍然可以执行。
296	- 三组用同一份输入，不随机化，保证可比。
297	
298	### 4.3 各组配置
299	
300	| 组 | 配置 |
301	|---|---|
302	| **Self Review** | 1 个 Bot：`execute`（做新需求并交付）→ `self_check`（同一 role：「按上线标准逐条自查，可用取证工具，修复后提交最终版」）；`on_completion` |
303	| **Executor + Reviewer** | `executor` 实现 → `reviewer` 以 `review` 验收（「按上线标准通读代码并取证，列出问题，结论通过或退回」）；退回就自动返工，最多 3 轮 |
304	| **Executor + Reviewer + Auditor** | 在上一组基础上，Reviewer 通过后由 `auditor` 做第二道验收：「逐条上线标准给出取证证据（取证工具输出或代码位置），没有证据的项视为不通过」。两者都通过才验收；任一退回都返工，最多 3 轮 |
305	
306	- 同一模型、同一取证工具、时限 45 分钟。
307	- **要新开发**：审核链（Controller `reviewer_refs` 依次验收、返工带上全部意见、Go 测试）；植入脚本、探测用例、诱饵；LLM 把审核意见对应到 bug 编号。
308	
309	### 4.4 判定
310	
311	- **主指标：缺陷逃逸率**。在最终交付版本上跑 12 个探测用例，仍失败的算逃逸。
312	- 次指标：
313	  - 检出率：审核或自查意见里提到的 bug，由 LLM 按清单对应并人工抽查；
314	  - 修复率；
315	  - 误报率、诱饵被指次数；
316	  - 回归数：金标基线用例在最终版上失败的数量；
317	  - 新需求（新练习）是否通过；
318	  - Verifier 误批率：系统内验收通过、但逃逸 > 1 或有回归。
319	- Goal Success：新需求通过，逃逸 ≤ 1，回归 = 0。
320	
321	---
322	
323	## 5. EXP-04｜开放式优化（30 分钟）
324	
325	### 5.1 问题与假设
326	
327	- **问题**：没有具体任务的开放改进，中央一次性拆分和运行时自主发现加动态认领，哪个更好？什么时候中央分解应该让位于运行时的工作发现？
328	- **对应假设**：**H6 自组织收益**（主）；H2（次，看重复工作和冲突）。
329	
330	### 5.2 任务
331	
332	**输入**：
333	- 一份**已经能运行**的课件，即 EXP-03 的金标版本；
334	- 再植入一组与 EXP-03 不同的「改进机会」，共 15 个，清单隐藏。这些机会**不全是 bug**：
335	
336	| 类 | 机会（示例） | 能否确定性检测 |
337	|---|---|---|
338	| 正确性 | 2 个轻量 bug：例题答案笔误；Δ = 0 时显示两个相同的根而不是「一个根」 | 能 |
339	| 交互 | 缺「重置参数」；滑块没有数值显示；练习做完后没有「再来一题」 | 能（元素存在且行为正确） |
340	| 教学 | 缺开口方向与 a 关系的动态演示说明；缺常见误区提示 | 部分（存在性检查，质量用 LLM） |
341	| 移动端 | 375 px 下字号过小（< 14 px） | 能 |
342	| 无障碍 | 焦点样式被 `outline: none` 去掉；图像没有文本替代描述 | 能 |
343	| 性能 | 每次 input 事件重建整个 SVG（拖动卡顿） | 能（拖动 100 次的耗时阈值，3 次取中位） |
344	| 视觉 | 坐标轴标签与曲线颜色对比度不足 | 能（对比度计算） |
345	
346	**给 Agent 的任务**（两组逐字相同）：
347	
348	> 这是一个已经能运行的二次函数互动课件 `input/lesson.html`。你们有 30 分钟，尽可能改善它（正确性、交互、教学、手机、可访问性、性能都可以）。不要破坏已有功能。30 分钟到时，以当时的最新版本为准。
349	
350	### 5.3 各组配置
351	
352	两组都是 **3 名同质 worker**（improver-a/b/c，同一角色说明），同一模型、同一取证工具，Run 时限 30 分钟。
353	
354	| 组 | 配置 |
355	|---|---|
356	| **中央 Planner** | LLM Leader 在开局**只决定一次**（`plan_once`）：查看课件和取证结果，一次性列出改进任务和依赖（DAG），派给三名 worker；之后只能 `wait` 或 `complete`。每个任务交出新版本时都要带上 base 版本 |
357	| **动态认领池** | 不用 Leader 分解。每名 worker 空闲时由 Controller 给一个「发现」任务：看当前最新版本和池子 → 可以加新工作项（标题、理由、证据）→ 原子认领一项（已被认领的不能再认领，认领有租约）→ 认领后成为该 worker 的执行任务 → 交出新版本（带 base hash）→ 用取证工具验证 → 再次空闲，循环到时限 |
358	
359	**两组共用的新开发**：
360	- **Run 时限**：到点停止派发，取消正在执行的 attempt（取消后由宿主证明已停止，沿用 T 阶段修复），最终版本取「当前版本」指针。
361	- **当前版本 CAS**：每个 Run 有一个「当前成果版本」指针。交新版本时要带 base hash，不等于当前版本就以 `STALE_BASE` 拒绝，worker 需要基于新版本重做。这就是「产物集成冲突」的计量来源。
362	- 只读规则（P5 = A）不变：改动以新版本提交到产物存储，不写项目文件。
363	
364	**动态认领池专用的新开发**：
365	- 工作项表：状态 open、claimed、done、abandoned；
366	- 原子认领：CAS 加租约；
367	- 「发现」任务的自动生成；
368	- 工具 `squad_pool_list` / `squad_pool_add` / `squad_pool_claim` / `squad_pool_release`；
369	- 页面上显示池子（可选，不影响实验）。
370	
371	### 5.4 判定
372	
373	- **主指标**：最终版本实现的改进机会数，按 15 项的确定性检查计；只有存在性检查的项加 LLM 质量门槛。
374	- **门槛**：回归 = 0（金标基线用例全部通过）。
375	- Goal Success：无回归，且实现 ≥ 5 项。5 是建议值，拍板时可调。
376	- 次指标：
377	  - LLM 两两盲比（同一轮次的两组最终版本对比，再分别与输入对比）；
378	  - 不在清单里、但确实有改进的项（LLM 归类、人工确认，单独计）；
379	  - Useful Work Ratio；
380	  - 重复工作率；
381	  - `STALE_BASE` 次数；
382	  - 认领后放弃的次数。
383	- 中央 Planner 组另记：开局任务清单覆盖了多少个机会，用来直接回答「Planner 能否在开始时预测到问题」。

387	## 6. 已知阻碍与对策
388	
389	| 阻碍 | 来源 | 对策 |
390	|---|---|---|
391	| **机器挂起**：上次 C 组 60 分钟里约 45 分钟挂起，多轮测试被 1.5～22 分钟的空白打断 | 总结 §8、§19-15 | ① 用 `systemd-inhibit --what=sleep:idle` 包住整个 runner（有就用，开跑前核实是否生效；挂起如果来自宿主虚拟机暂停，这个办法无效，要换机器，见决策 10）；② runner 每秒比较墙钟增量与单调时钟增量，差值记为 `suspended_seconds`，大于 0 的运行标为环境中断、不计入、自动重跑一次；③ O1 的暂停宽限和 O7 的自动对账已经能减少挂起后的人工确认，但挂起仍会改变墙钟和时限，所以仍然排除 |
392	| **runner 10 分钟上限**：第一轮 C 组被截停 | 总结 §8 | 每个实验单独设时限：EXP-01 30 分钟、EXP-02 60 分钟、EXP-03 45 分钟、EXP-04 固定 30 分钟（时限在 Controller 里，到点收尾而不是判失败）。超时计为 Runtime Failure，不悄悄丢弃 |
393	| **人工介入计数不准**：报告记 0，实际 2 次（在 Controller 上直接操作） | 总结 §8 | 人工介入从 Controller 事件里统计 operator 主体的所有操作，不再靠脚本自报。实验期间约定不人工干预；一旦干预，该运行标记出来，单独报告 |

395	| **工具不对等**：自由模式有 bash 和写文件，受控任务只读、没有浏览器 | O7 P5 = A；`browser.js` 只在桌面版 | 所有组都放进 Squad，并给所有组同一个取证工具（§1.2）。原来的 S 组（自由模式）不作为基线 |
396	| **LLM Leader 的额外开销和随机性** | 真实 Run 中 12 次 Leader 决定 | 固定分解的组用固定编排 Leader；只有 EXP-04 中央 Planner 用 LLM Leader |
397	| **v0.2.0 上没有真实模型端到端** | 总结 §19-3、§17.1 | D0：先在 v0.2.0 上用真实模型跑一次现有数学课件，作为冒烟；不通过就先修 |
398	| **判题泄漏** | — | 判题、bug 清单、机会清单都在项目目录外；开跑前做一个负例确认读不到；取证工具不包含判题用例 |
399	| **B1 和 Self Review 的上下文延续** | 未核实 | D0 里核实同一 role 的连续任务是否在同一会话。如果不在，B1 的后续步骤通过 `refs` 拿到前一步的完整结果，并在报告里写明 |
400	| **API 错误或限流** | — | 单次请求的重试沿用 DSH 的机制；整次运行因 API 失败中止的，计为 Runtime Failure，可以重跑一次，两次都记录 |
401	| **判题不稳定** | — | 每个用例跑 3 次，不一致就修判题后对全部成果重判（成果已存档，可以重判） |
402	| **样本小** | — | 不报显著性；按 §1.5 规则措辞；结论写「在 deepseek-flash、n = 5 下」 |
403	| **key 安全** | AGENTS.md、O6 | 只从 `~/.secrets/deepseek.env` 读入环境变量；报告、日志、截图、成果入库或外发前做 `sk-` 模式和精确值扫描 |
404	| **mock 不能评质量** | — | mock 只用来空跑全部组，验证流程和判题；数字不进结论 |
```

```text
    fix(dsh-exp): judge checks fail individually; judging never changes a Run's outcome
    
    The first real EXP-01 round stopped with outcome "error" because B0's page
    had no window.lesson.practice(); the judge threw and the runner recorded
    that as the Run's error, and the artifact bytes were left in the report.
    Now each judge check runs under its own guard (a throw fails that check with
    its reason), judging is wrapped in the runner separately (judge_error), and
    the artifact text is dropped as soon as the file is written. Verified on the
    golden page (all pass), the four broken variants (each fails its own check),
    and a variant without practice() (only R5 fails, with the reason).
```

```text
1	// Experiment runner v2 (EXP-01 to EXP-04, docs/dsh-squad-EXP01-04-实验计划-2026-10-29.md).
2	// Every arm of an experiment is a team in DS Bot + Squad. Each run gets a fresh project
3	// directory (D12), the same goal, and the same model; the final artifact is judged by
4	// deterministic scripts outside the project, and nothing here calls an LLM.
5	//
6	//   node dsh_squad/experiments/exp/run.mjs <exp> [--arms B0,B1,P1] [--repeats 5]
7	//        [--minutes 30] [--port 3600] [--mock]
8	//
9	// Arms and their templates come from specs/<exp>.json and templates/<exp>/<arm>/.
10	// Arms run interleaved by repeat (round 1 of every arm, then round 2, ...). A run during
11	// which the machine slept is marked environment_interrupted and run again once (plan §6).
12	// Writes dsh-squad-experiment/2 into reports/ (not committed). Evidence stays local.
13	import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
14	import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
15	import { cpSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
16	import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path'
17	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
18	import { judgeExp01 } from './judges/exp01.mjs'
19	
20	const HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
21	const SQUAD = dirname(dirname(HERE))
22	const CLI = join(SQUAD, 'deploy', 'dsh-squad')
23	const RUNS = join(HERE, '.runs')
24	const REPORTS = join(HERE, 'reports')
25	const JUDGES = { exp01: judgeExp01 }
26	
27	const [expId, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2)
28	const option = (name, fallback) => { const i = rest.indexOf(`--${name}`); return i === -1 ? fallback : rest[i + 1] }
29	const mock = rest.includes('--mock') || !process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
30	const spec = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(HERE, 'specs', `${expId}.json`), 'utf8'))
31	const arms = option('arms', spec.arms.join(',')).split(',').map(arm => arm.trim()).filter(Boolean)
32	const repeats = Math.max(1, Number(option('repeats', String(spec.repeats))))
33	const basePort = Number(option('port', '3600'))
34	const limitMs = Number(option('minutes', String(spec.minutes))) * 60_000
35	const sleep = ms => new Promise(done => setTimeout(done, ms))
36	const judge = JUDGES[expId]
37	if (!judge) { console.error(`no judge for ${expId}`); process.exit(2) }
38	
39	// Wall-clock jumps that monotonic time does not show are sleeps: a laptop lid, a VM pause.
40	// Accumulated over the run; any run with more than 5 s of it is environment-interrupted.
41	const sleeps = { ms: 0 }
42	let lastWall = Date.now()
43	let lastMono = performance.now()
44	const watch = setInterval(() => {
45	  const wall = Date.now() - lastWall
46	  const mono = performance.now() - lastMono
47	  if (wall - mono > 5000) sleeps.ms += wall - mono
48	  lastWall = Date.now()
49	  lastMono = performance.now()
50	}, 1000)
51	watch.unref()
52	
53	async function host(project) {
54	  const login = readFileSync(join(project, '.dsh-squad/logs/web.log'), 'utf8').match(/http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1:\d+\/\?token=\S+/g).at(-1)
55	  const base = new URL(login).origin
56	  const cookie = (await fetch(login, { redirect: 'manual' })).headers.getSetCookie().map(entry => entry.split(';')[0]).join('; ')
57	  const call = route => async (endpoint, payload = {}) => {
58	    const out = await (await fetch(`${base}${route}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', cookie }, body: JSON.stringify({ endpoint, payload }) })).json()
59	    if (!out.ok) throw new Error(`${endpoint}: ${out.error?.message}`)
60	    return out.value
61	  }
62	  const squad = call('/api/squad-adapter')
63	  return { ui: (endpoint, payload) => squad(`ui/${endpoint}`, payload) }
64	}
65	
66	// Final artifact: the content of the artifact the named step's accepted result carries.
67	// Fetched from the Controller on loopback (the artifact route needs no credential).
68	async function finalArtifact(project, tasks, step) {
69	  const controller = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(project, '.agents/dshsquad/.runtime/controller.json'), 'utf8'))
70	  const task = tasks.filter(t => t.title === step && t.kind !== 'review').at(-1)
71	  const art = task?.result?.artifacts?.find(a => a.name === spec.artifact)
72	  if (!art) return { task: task?.task_id ?? null, bytes: null, sha256: null, path: null, accepted: false }
73	  const hex = String(art.sha256).replace(/^sha256[/:]/, '')
74	  const response = await fetch(`${controller.endpoint}/v2/artifacts/sha256/${hex}`)
75	  const bytes = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer())
76	  const digest = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex')
77	  return { task: task.task_id, bytes: bytes.length, sha256: digest === hex ? hex : `MISMATCH ${digest}`, text: bytes, accepted: task.acceptance?.decision === 'accepted' }
78	}
79	
80	function prepare(arm, project) {
81	  rmSync(project, { recursive: true, force: true })
82	  mkdirSync(project, { recursive: true })
83	  cpSync(join(HERE, 'templates', expId, arm, '.agents'), join(project, '.agents'), { recursive: true })
84	}
85	
86	function cli(project, ...more) {
87	  return execFileSync(CLI, [...more, project, ...(mock ? ['--mock'] : []), '--port', String(basePort)], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] })
88	}
89	
90	async function runOnce(arm, index) {
91	  const project = join(RUNS, `${expId}-${arm}-${index}`)
92	  prepare(arm, project)
93	  const sleptBefore = sleeps.ms
94	  const started = Date.now()
95	  const record = { arm, repeat: index + 1, project, outcome: 'not run', run_id: null, seconds: null, suspended_seconds: 0, environment_interrupted: false, final: null, judge: null, error: null }
96	  try {
97	    cli(project, 'up')
98	    const { ui } = await host(project)
99	    const run = await ui('start-run', { requestId: `${expId}-${arm}-${index}-${Date.now()}`, teamId: spec.team, goal: spec.goal })
100	    record.run_id = run.run_id
101	    let current
102	    let tasks = []
103	    for (const deadline = Date.now() + limitMs; Date.now() < deadline;) {
104	      await sleep(2000)
105	      const snap = (await ui('view')).snapshot
106	      current = snap.views.runs.find(candidate => candidate.run_id === run.run_id)
107	      tasks = snap.views.tasks.filter(task => task.run_id === run.run_id)
108	      if (['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'interrupted'].includes(current?.phase)) break
109	    }
110	    record.outcome = current?.phase ?? 'timed out'
111	    record.phase_at_end = current?.phase ?? null
112	    record.final = await finalArtifact(project, tasks, spec.final_steps?.[arm] ?? spec.final_step)
113	    record.counts = { tasks: tasks.length, kinds: tasks.reduce((acc, t) => ({ ...acc, [t.kind]: (acc[t.kind] ?? 0) + 1 }), {}) }
114	    if (record.final.text) {
115	      const file = join(project, 'final', spec.artifact)
116	      mkdirSync(dirname(file), { recursive: true })
117	      writeFileSync(file, record.final.text)
118	      delete record.final.text
119	      // Judging is separate from the Run: a judge failure is recorded as judge_error and
120	      // leaves the Run's outcome as the Controller reported it.
121	      try {
122	        const runs = []
123	        for (let round = 0; round < 3; round += 1) runs.push(await judge(file))
124	        const first = JSON.stringify(runs[0].checks.map(c => [c.id, c.ok]))
125	        record.judge = { ...runs[0], consistent: runs.every(r => JSON.stringify(r.checks.map(c => [c.id, c.ok])) === first) }
126	      } catch (error) {
127	        record.judge_error = String(error.message ?? error).slice(0, 400)
128	      }
129	    }
130	  } catch (error) {
131	    record.error = String(error.message ?? error).slice(0, 400)
132	    record.outcome = 'error'
133	  } finally {
134	    try { cli(project, 'down') } catch { /* already down */ }
135	    record.seconds = Math.round((Date.now() - started) / 100) / 10
136	    record.suspended_seconds = Math.round((sleeps.ms - sleptBefore) / 100) / 10
137	    record.environment_interrupted = record.suspended_seconds > 5
138	  }
139	  return record
140	}
141	
142	const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')
143	const report = {
144	  schema: 'dsh-squad-experiment/2',
145	  id: `${expId}-${stamp}`,
146	  experiment: expId,
147	  title: spec.title,
148	  created: new Date().toISOString(),
149	  mock,
150	  model: mock ? { provider: 'mock', model: 'ds-bot mock + squad mock', effort: null } : { provider: 'deepseek-official', model: 'deepseek-flash', effort: 'high' },
151	  arms,
152	  repeats,
153	  task: { goal: spec.goal, artifact: spec.artifact, final_steps: spec.final_steps ?? { all: spec.final_step } },
154	  runs: [],
155	}
156	const path = join(REPORTS, `${report.id}.json`)
157	function write() {
158	  mkdirSync(REPORTS, { recursive: true })
159	  writeFileSync(path, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`)
160	}
161	mkdirSync(RUNS, { recursive: true })
162	for (let round = 0; round < repeats; round += 1) {
163	  for (const [armIndex, arm] of arms.entries()) {
164	    console.log(`== ${expId} ${arm} round ${round + 1}/${repeats}`)
165	    let record = await runOnce(arm, round * 10 + armIndex)
166	    if (record.environment_interrupted) {
167	      console.log(`   environment interrupted (${record.suspended_seconds}s asleep); running once more`)
168	      record.discarded_first = true
169	      report.runs.push(record)
170	      record = await runOnce(arm, round * 10 + armIndex)
171	    }
172	    report.runs.push(record)
173	    const passed = record.judge?.goal_success === true
174	    console.log(`   ${record.outcome} ${record.seconds}s goal_success=${passed} ${record.judge ? `coverage=${record.judge.requirement_coverage.toFixed(2)}` : (record.judge_error ?? record.error ?? 'no artifact')}`)
175	    write()
176	  }
177	}
178	write()
179	console.log(`report: ${path}`)
```

```text
2	// requirements R1-R8 and the interface contract the task gives every arm (see

9	const GRID = Array.from({ length: 41 }, (_, i) => -4 + i * 0.25) // x = -4 .. 6
10	const FIXED_CURVES = [{ a: 1, b: -2, c: -3 }, { a: -2, b: 4, c: 1 }, { a: 0.5, b: 1, c: -4 }]

15	// Vertex, axis and roots of y = ax^2 + bx + c, from the formulas.
16	function facts({ a, b, c }) {
17	  const h = -b / (2 * a)
18	  const k = c - (b * b) / (4 * a)
19	  const delta = b * b - 4 * a * c
20	  const roots = delta > 0 ? [(-b + Math.sqrt(delta)) / (2 * a), (-b - Math.sqrt(delta)) / (2 * a)] : delta === 0 ? [h] : []
21	  return { h, k, delta, roots }
22	}
23	
24	// Ten parameter sets with a != 0, covering delta > 0, = 0 and < 0. Fixed seed.
25	function paramSets() {
26	  const rand = seeded()
27	  const pick = (lo, hi) => Math.round((lo + rand() * (hi - lo)) * 2) / 2
28	  const sets = [{ a: 1, b: -4, c: 4 }, { a: -1, b: 0, c: -1 }] // delta = 0 and delta < 0 included
29	  while (sets.length < 10) {
30	    let a = pick(-3, 3)
31	    if (a === 0) a = 1
32	    sets.push({ a, b: pick(-6, 6), c: pick(-6, 6) })
33	  }
34	  return sets
35	}
36	
37	async function setParams(page, params) {
38	  await page.evaluate(p => window.lesson.setParams(p), params)
39	  await settle(page)
40	}

42	// R1: the drawn curve follows f(x) on x in [-4, 6]. Each point of f inside the plot must
43	// lie on the drawn path; the path is read with getPointAtLength in the SVG's own coordinates.
44	async function curveMatches(page, params) {
45	  await setParams(page, params)
46	  const expected = await page.evaluate((p, xs) => {
47	    const curve = document.querySelector('[data-testid=curve]')
48	    if (!curve || !curve.ownerSVGElement) return { error: 'no [data-testid=curve] inside an svg' }
49	    const box = curve.ownerSVGElement.viewBox.baseVal
50	    const points = xs.map(x => window.lesson.toPixel(x, p.a * x * x + p.b * x + p.c))
51	    const inside = points.filter(([px, py]) => Number.isFinite(px) && Number.isFinite(py) && px >= box.x && px <= box.x + box.width && py >= box.y && py <= box.y + box.height)
52	    const length = curve.getTotalLength()
53	    const drawn = []
54	    for (let s = 0; s <= length; s += length / 600) { const q = curve.getPointAtLength(s); drawn.push([q.x, q.y]) }
55	    return { inside, drawn, tol: 0.012 * Math.max(box.width, box.height) }
56	  }, params, GRID)
57	  if (expected.error) return { ok: false, detail: expected.error }
58	  if (expected.inside.length < 10) return { ok: false, detail: `only ${expected.inside.length} of 41 points of f inside the plot` }
59	  const far = expected.inside.filter(([px, py]) => !expected.drawn.some(([dx, dy]) => Math.hypot(dx - px, dy - py) <= expected.tol))
60	  return far.length === 0 ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, detail: `${far.length} of ${expected.inside.length} points of f are off the drawn curve (tolerance ${expected.tol.toFixed(1)})` }
61	}

63	async function sliderMoves(page) {
64	  const seen = []
65	  for (const name of ['a', 'b', 'c']) {
66	    const value = name === 'a' ? 2 : -3
67	    const ok = await page.evaluate((n, v) => {
68	      const slider = document.querySelector(`[data-testid=slider-${n}]`)
69	      if (!slider) return 'missing'
70	      slider.value = String(v)
71	      slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
72	      slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
73	      return window.lesson.getParams()[n] === v ? 'ok' : `params.${n} is ${window.lesson.getParams()[n]}`
74	    }, name, value)
75	    await settle(page)
76	    seen.push(`${name}:${ok}`)
77	  }
78	  return seen.every(entry => entry.endsWith(':ok')) ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, detail: seen.join(' ') }
79	}

86	async function factsText(page, sets) {

88	  for (const params of sets) {

92	    const axis = numbersIn(await textFor(page, 'axis'))
93	    const rootsText = await textFor(page, 'roots')

96	    if (!axis.some(v => near(v, h))) bad.push(`axis ${label}`)
97	    if (delta < 0) {

99	    } else {

102	      if (!ok) bad.push(`roots ${label}`)

104	  }
105	  return bad.length === 0 ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, detail: bad.slice(0, 4).join('; ') + (bad.length > 4 ? ` (+${bad.length - 4})` : '') }

114	  const weak = []

119	  return weak.length === 0 ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, detail: `missing or unrelated text: ${weak.join(', ')}` }

124	async function practice(page) {

150	}

153	async function mobileLayout(browser, file) {
154	  const { page, external, errors } = await openPage(browser, file, MOBILE)
155	  const width = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)
156	  const outside = await page.evaluate(() => ['slider-a', 'slider-b', 'slider-c', 'practice-submit'].filter(id => {

166	// R8: names and keyboard reach for each control, feedback as text, and axe on the page.
167	async function accessibility(page) {

169	  const unfocusable = await page.evaluate(ids => ids.filter(id => {
170	    const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid=${id}]`)
171	    if (!el) return true

188	export async function judgeExp01(file) {

194	      add(id, level, await body())

216	      await guard('R4', 'must', () => explanations(page))
```

```text
--- fixed.go ---
package scheduler

import (
	"database/sql"

	"github.com/kms9/pi-learn/dsh_squad/controller/project"
	"github.com/kms9/pi-learn/dsh_squad/controller/task"
)

// fixedReworkLimit bounds how many times one result may be reworked after rejections
// (EXP-03 uses three). The review that follows a rework is created by ensureReviews.
const fixedReworkLimit = 3

// ensureFixedFlow runs a Run of a Team in leader mode "fixed" without an LLM Leader. The
// workflow was materialized when the Run was created. Here the Controller marks the Run
// running once it is admitted, plans one rework for each rejected result (within the
// limit), and completes the Run when the same final check a Leader's "complete" meets
// passes. Nothing is accepted that a Leader could not have accepted.
func (s *Service) ensureFixedFlow(tx *sql.Tx) error {
	runs, err := readRuns(tx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, r := range runs {
		if !r.Admitted || r.RecoveryHold || task.Terminal(r.Phase) || r.Config.Config.Leader.Mode != "fixed" {
			continue
		}
		tasks, err := readTasks(tx)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := s.planFixedReworks(tx, r, tasks); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if r.Phase == "planning" {
			r.Phase = "running"
			r.Revision++
			if err := task.SaveRun(tx, r); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if err := s.finalGate(tx, r, ""); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		r.Phase = "completed"
		r.Revision++
		if err := s.cleanupRun(tx, &r); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := task.SaveRun(tx, r); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := task.EventTx(tx, "fixed_flow_completed", r.ID, r.Revision, map[string]string{"run_id": r.ID}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// planFixedReworks plans one rework for each rejected result of the Run that has no rework
// yet. The rework takes the rejected task's dependencies and refs and carries the
// reviewer's reason in its goal. The rejected result stays rejected until the rework is
// accepted, so the final check keeps refusing the Run in the meantime.
func (s *Service) planFixedReworks(tx *sql.Tx, r task.Run, tasks []task.Contract) error {
	byID := map[string]task.Contract{}
	for _, c := range tasks {
		byID[c.ID] = c
	}
	for _, c := range tasks {
		if c.RunID == nil || *c.RunID != r.ID || c.Kind == "review" || c.Kind == "leader_step" || c.Acceptance == nil || c.Acceptance.Decision != "rejected" || c.SupersededBy != "" {
			continue
		}
		if hasRework(tasks, c.ID) || reworkDepth(byID, c) >= fixedReworkLimit {
			continue
		}
		step := project.Step{
			ID: "rework", RoleRef: c.RoleID, Kind: "execute",
			Goal: c.Goal + "\n\n审核退回，意见：" + c.Acceptance.Reason, ReworkOf: c.ID,
			DependsOn: []project.Dependency{}, Refs: append([]project.ResultRef{}, c.Refs...),
		}
		for _, d := range c.Dependencies {
			step.DependsOn = append(step.DependsOn, project.Dependency{Step: d.TaskID, Condition: d.Condition})
		}
		w := project.Workflow{SchemaVersion: 1, WorkflowID: "fixed-rework", Steps: []project.Step{step}}
		if err := s.materialize(tx, r, w, task.Origin{Kind: "rework", By: c.ID}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := task.EventTx(tx, "fixed_rework_planned", c.ID, c.Revision, map[string]string{"run_id": r.ID}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// hasRework says whether a live rework already replaces the task.
func hasRework(tasks []task.Contract, id string) bool {
	for _, c := range tasks {
		if c.ReworkOf == id && c.State != "cancelled" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// reworkDepth counts the rework links behind a task: 0 for an original result.
func reworkDepth(byID map[string]task.Contract, c task.Contract) int {
	depth := 0
	for cur := c; cur.ReworkOf != "" && depth <= len(byID); depth++ {
		next, ok := byID[cur.ReworkOf]
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		cur = next
	}
	return depth
}
```

定位到根因了。`scheduler/runs.go:239` 把工作流步骤自己的 `step.Goal`（B0 里只有一句「按任务说明完成 lesson.html」）作为任务目标，而 Run 的 `r.Goal`（也就是真正的任务说明）只在 LLM Leader 的 `leader_step` 里用到。固定编排模式没有 Leader，所以任务说明从来没有进入任何步骤任务。我看一下 `materialize` 的完整上下文，确认修复位置。

```text
func (s *Service) materialize(tx *sql.Tx, r task.Run, w project.Workflow, origin task.Origin) error {
	ids := map[string]string{}
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		id, err := project.RandomID("task-")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ids[step.ID] = id
	}
	for _, step := range w.Steps {
		c := baseTask(ids[step.ID], step.Kind, step.Goal, r.Config.Config.Policy)
		c.Scope = "team"
		c.RunID = &r.ID
		c.TeamID = &r.TeamID
		c.RoleID = step.RoleRef
		c.Source = r.Source
		c.ReworkOf = resolveStep(ids, step.ReworkOf)
		c.Title = strings.TrimSpace(step.Title)
		c.Origin = &task.Origin{Kind: origin.Kind, By: origin.By}
		if c.ReworkOf != "" {
			c.Origin = &task.Origin{Kind: "rework", By: c.ReworkOf}
			if _, local := ids[step.ReworkOf]; !local {
				if err := s.reworkable(tx, c); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		c.Dependencies = []task.Dependency{}
		c.ExpectedOutput = step.ExpectedOutput
		c.AcceptanceCriteria = step.Acceptance
		c.Refs = append([]project.ResultRef{}, step.Refs...)
		for index := range c.Refs {
			c.Refs[index].TaskID = resolveStep(ids, c.Refs[index].TaskID)
		}
		c.WriteSet = step.WriteSet
		for _, d := range step.DependsOn {
			c.Dependencies = append(c.Dependencies, task.Dependency{TaskID: resolveStep(ids, d.Step), Condition: d.Condition})
		}
		if step.Kind == "review" {
			c.AcceptancePolicy = nil
			c.Goal += "\n提交结构化审查 value={decision:accepted|rejected,reason:string,candidates:[{task_id,result_revision,hash}]}；所有候选必须为本任务 execution_completed 依赖的精确结果。"
		}
		if step.Kind == "ask" {
			if len(c.WriteSet) > 0 {
				return task.Reject("READ_ONLY", "ask cannot write")
			}
			c.AllowedTools = []string{}
		}
		if err := task.SaveTask(tx, c); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// reworkable says whether a planned rework may replace its task: one a review rejected,
// or one built on a version that was replaced since (Q41). The Leader choosing to redo
// such a task is what a person does with 「用新版本重做」: the old version is marked
// replaced now, so the redo can be accepted later. Anything else is refused at plan
// time with a reason, instead of a redo that could never be accepted.
```

```text
# Controller 开发规范（DSH Squad）

本目录是 DSH Squad 的 Go 控制面。2026-10-19 决策 D1：从 `pi_squad/controller` 复制过来后独立演进，不与 `pi_squad` 共用；`pi_squad` 不再维护。唯一支持的宿主是 `dsh/0.2.1-rc.2+ds-bot/ae63b45`（`project.HostProfile`，D9）。

Gin、Resty、Viper、Cobra、Bubble Tea 只允许出现在本目录。Adapter（`dsh_squad/adapter`）和客户端插件是 JavaScript，不引入这些库。

## 语言与模块

- Go `1.27.0`，`go.mod` 的 `go` 行保持 `1.27.0`。
- Module：`github.com/kms9/pi-learn/dsh_squad/controller`。

## 技术栈

| 职责 | 模块 | 版本 |
|------|------|------|
| HTTP 服务 | `github.com/gin-gonic/gin` | `v1.12.0` |
| HTTP 客户端 | `github.com/go-resty/resty/v2` | `v2.17.2` |
| 配置 | `github.com/spf13/viper` | `v1.21.0` |
| 命令 | `github.com/spf13/cobra` | `v1.10.2` |
| TUI | `github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea` / `bubbles` / `lipgloss` | `v1.3.10` / `v1.0.0` / `v1.1.0` |
| SQLite | `modernc.org/sqlite` | 见 `go.mod` |

## 进程与项目

- `serve` 从 cwd 或 `--project-root` 找最近的 `.agents/dshsquad/`，持进程锁，数据库默认 `.agents/dshsquad/.runtime/state.sqlite`，监听 `127.0.0.1:0`，把 endpoint 原子写进 `.runtime/controller.json`。一个项目目录只有一个 Controller（D4）。
- 环境变量前缀 `DSH_SQUAD_`（如 `DSH_SQUAD_LISTEN`、`DSH_SQUAD_CONTROLLER_URL`）。优先级：flag > 环境变量 > `--config` 文件 > 默认值。
- 协议 `squad/3`（D3），写请求带 `X-Squad-Protocol`、`X-Squad-Controller`；runtime 再带 `X-Squad-Agent`、`X-Squad-Binding`。契约见 `dsh_squad/protocol/README.md`。
- 不在 Controller 里启动 DSH 宿主；配对启动由 `dsh_squad/deploy` 负责。

## 改动约束

- 业务 Task 没有固定截止时间（2026-10-04 决策）；lease、心跳是通信层的，不能据此判定业务结果。
- 新的可用命令、配置和接口同步写进 `dsh_squad/USAGE.md`；没落地的不写。
- 中间阶段要求 `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` 通过（`dsh_squad/scripts/check.sh`）。
--- scripts/check.sh ---
#!/bin/sh
# The minimum check for every work package (2026-10-19 plan, X-1): the Controller
# builds, vets and passes its tests; the adapter passes its tests; the seam patch
# applies to the pinned ds-bot and ds-bot's own tests pass on the result.
#
#   dsh_squad/scripts/check.sh [--skip-ds-bot]
set -eu
SQUAD="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
echo "== controller"
(cd "$SQUAD/controller" && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...)
for pkg in adapter client; do
  [ -f "$SQUAD/$pkg/package.json" ] || continue
  echo "== $pkg"
  (cd "$SQUAD/$pkg" && npm test --silent)
done
echo "== client bundle up to date"
(cd "$SQUAD/client" && node scripts/build.mjs --check)

package scheduler

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/kms9/pi-learn/dsh_squad/controller/project"
	"github.com/kms9/pi-learn/dsh_squad/controller/task"
)

// A Team in leader mode "fixed": the workflow runs without any Leader step.
func fixedHarness(t *testing.T) (*harness, string) {
	t.Helper()
	h := newHarness(t)
	files, _ := project.ConfigFiles(h.svc.Project.Root)
	hash := map[string]string{}
	content := map[string]string{}
	for _, f := range files {
		hash[f.Path], content[f.Path] = f.Hash, f.Content
	}
	team := strings.Replace(content["teams/math/team.json"], `{"responsibility":"build","role_ref":"builder"}`, `{"responsibility":"build","role_ref":"builder"},{"responsibility":"check","role_ref":"checker"}`, 1)
	team = strings.Replace(team, `"leader":{"agent_ref":"chief"}`, `"leader":{"agent_ref":"chief","mode":"fixed"}`, 1)
	if team == content["teams/math/team.json"] {
		t.Fatalf("fixture changed: %s", team)
	}
	if _, err := project.ApplyConfigEdits(h.svc.Project.Root, []project.ConfigEdit{
		{Path: "roles/checker/role.md", Content: roleDoc("checker")},
		{Path: "roles/checker/agents.md", Content: "Check.\n"},
		{Path: "teams/math/team.json", Content: team, ExpectedHash: hash["teams/math/team.json"]},
	}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h.registerLeader()
	h.register("math-builder", "builder", "bot-builder", "room-math", "sess-b")
	h.register("math-reviewer", "reviewer", "bot-reviewer", "room-math", "sess-r")
	h.registerAs("math-checker", "role", "checker", "math", "bot-checker", "room-math")
	r, err := h.svc.CreateRun(h.ctx, h.op, CreateRun{RequestID: "run1", TeamID: "math", Goal: "teach", WorkflowID: "lesson"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return h, r.ID
}

// The reviewer rejects the first build (drive does so), so the Controller plans one
// rework with its reason, the review of the rework is created by ensureReviews, and the
// Run completes without any Leader step.
func TestFixedFlowReworksARejectedResultAndCompletes(t *testing.T) {
	h, runID := fixedHarness(t)
	h.drive(runID, func([]task.Contract, []string) bool { return false })
	if r := h.runOf(runID); r.Phase != "completed" {
		t.Fatalf("phase %q, want completed", r.Phase)
	}
	var build, rework task.Contract
	for _, c := range h.runTasks(runID) {
		switch {
		case c.Kind == "leader_step":
			t.Fatalf("a Leader step was planned: %s", c.ID)
		case c.ReworkOf != "":
			rework = c
		case c.Kind == "execute":
			build = c
		}
	}
	if rework.ID == "" || rework.ReworkOf != build.ID {
		t.Fatalf("no rework of the rejected build: build=%+v rework=%+v", build.ID, rework.ID)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(rework.Goal, "审核退回，意见：checked") {
		t.Fatalf("the rework does not carry the reviewer's reason: %q", rework.Goal)
	}
	if build.SupersededBy != rework.ID {
		t.Fatalf("the rejected build is not superseded by its rework: %q", build.SupersededBy)
	}
}

func TestReworkDepthCountsTheChainOfReworks(t *testing.T) {
	original := task.Contract{ID: "a"}
	first := task.Contract{ID: "b", ReworkOf: "a"}
	second := task.Contract{ID: "c", ReworkOf: "b"}
	byID := map[string]task.Contract{"a": original, "b": first, "c": second}
	if got := reworkDepth(byID, original); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("original depth %d", got)
	}
	if got := reworkDepth(byID, second); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("second rework depth %d, want 2", got)
	}
}
```

```text
#!/bin/sh
# One project directory = one DS Bot host + one Squad Controller (2026-10-19 D4).
#
#   dsh_squad/deploy/dsh-squad up <project> [--port N] [--mock]
#   dsh_squad/deploy/dsh-squad provision <project>     # Chief, Researcher, Builder, Reviewer, a group, team memory
#   dsh_squad/deploy/dsh-squad status <project>
#   dsh_squad/deploy/dsh-squad down <project>
#
# Everything the pair keeps lives in <project>/.dsh-squad/: the DSH home (DS Bot's Bots,
# Sessions, memory), the Controller's database, logs and pid files. The Controller's own
# lock, discovery file and operator credential stay in .agents/dshsquad/.runtime/ (its
# contract); the adapter finds the Controller there. A project without .agents/dshsquad
# gets the default team (dsh_squad/deploy/template).
#
# The stack is pinned (D9): DSH from npm (probes/versions.lock.json) and the dsh-bot
# submodule's ds-bot with the seam patch, built into dsh_squad/.build on first use.
#
# Model: --mock runs ds-bot's scripted mock behind probes/squad-mock.mjs (no key).
# Otherwise the DeepSeek API: its key from DS Bot's settings page (DSH's credential store),
# or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the environment (never written down by this script),
# DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL optional (default https://api.deepseek.com).
set -eu
SQUAD="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
REPO="$(dirname "$SQUAD")"
BUILD="$SQUAD/.build"
DSH_VERSION=$(node -p "require('$REPO/probes/versions.lock.json').dsh.npm")
HARNESS="$BUILD/harness"
DSH="$HARNESS/node_modules/.bin/dsh"
CONTROLLER_BIN="$BUILD/controller"

usage() { sed -n '4,8p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
ACTION=${1:-}
[ -n "$ACTION" ] || usage
shift
[ $# -ge 1 ] || usage
mkdir -p "$1"
PROJECT="$(cd "$1" && pwd -P)"
shift
PORT=3400
MOCK=0
```

```text
#!/bin/sh
# Builds the patched ds-bot the P1 bench loads: the dsh-bot submodule's pinned commit,
# exported (the submodule itself stays untouched), plus dsh_squad/patches/ds-bot/*.patch.
#
#   dsh_squad/scripts/prepare-ds-bot.sh [--test]
#
# Output: dsh_squad/.build/ds-bot (gitignored), a git repo whose first commit is the
# upstream copy, so `git diff` there shows exactly what the patches change. --test runs
# ds-bot's unit tests on the result against dev/harness of the submodule.
set -eu
SQUAD="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
REPO="$(dirname "$SQUAD")"
OUT="$SQUAD/.build/ds-bot"
UPSTREAM="$(git -C "$REPO/dsh-bot" rev-parse HEAD)"

# --stamp prints what a build from the current submodule and patches would be made of.
if [ "${1:-}" = --stamp ]; then
  printf '%s %s\n' "$UPSTREAM" "$(cat "$SQUAD"/patches/ds-bot/*.patch | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  exit 0
fi
rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
git -C "$REPO/dsh-bot" archive "$UPSTREAM" ds-bot | tar -x -C "$OUT" --strip-components=1
cd "$OUT"
git init -q
git add -A
git -c user.name=prepare -c user.email=prepare@localhost commit -qm "ds-bot at dsh-bot $UPSTREAM"
for patch in "$SQUAD"/patches/ds-bot/*.patch; do
  git apply --whitespace=nowarn "$patch"
  echo "applied $(basename "$patch")"
done
# Build tools and the test harness come from the submodule's own installs.
[ -d "$REPO/dsh-bot/ds-bot/node_modules" ] && ln -sfn "$REPO/dsh-bot/ds-bot/node_modules" node_modules
printf 'node_modules\n' >> .git/info/exclude
git diff --stat
# What this build is made of, so a later run knows when the submodule or a patch moved.
printf '.squad-build\n' >> .git/info/exclude
"$SQUAD/scripts/prepare-ds-bot.sh" --stamp > .squad-build
if [ "${1:-}" = --test ]; then
  DSH_HARNESS="$REPO/dsh-bot/ds-bot/dev/harness" node --import ./test/harness-resolve.mjs --test "test/*.test.js"
fi
--- harness package.json ---
{
  "name": "ds-bot-test-harness",
  "private": true,
  "description": "The DeepSeek Harness packages that the unit tests and the linter run against. Install with npm run harness in ds-bot/.",
  "dependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh": "0.2.1-rc.2",
    "jsdom": "29.1.1",
    "oxlint": "1.76.0"
  }
}
package.json
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
// Which tools an admitted attempt may call. Pure. The Controller speaks of the tools
// in a Task contract (read, grep, find, ls, write, edit); the DSH host serves its own
// names. Squad's task tools are always open inside an attempt and nowhere else.
// Anything not listed — shell, run_code, message_bot, post_to_group, MCP — is refused
// in a formal attempt, because its side effects cannot be fenced (MIGRATION_PLAN §5).

export const TASK_TOOLS = ['squad_task', 'squad_submit_result', 'squad_review', 'squad_decide', 'squad_yield', 'squad_delegate', 'squad_clarify']

const DSH_NAMES = {
  read: ['read', 'read_image'],
  grep: ['grep'],
  find: ['glob'],
  ls: ['glob'],
  write: ['write'],
  edit: ['edit', 'str_replace_editor'],
}

// Memory inside a formal attempt is a read-only view (2026-10-19 D12): recall reads it,
// remember and forget would change what later steps and other Runs start from.
const MEMORY_READ = ['recall']
const MEMORY_WRITE = ['remember', 'forget']

/** DSH tool names for a contract's allowed tools, task tools included. */
export function hostTools(allowed = []) {
  const out = new Set([...TASK_TOOLS, ...MEMORY_READ])
  for (const name of allowed) for (const host of DSH_NAMES[name] ?? []) out.add(host)
  return out
}

/**
 * Why a call is refused, or undefined when it may run.
 * @param {string} name  the DSH tool name
 * @param {{allowedTools?: string[]}|undefined} attempt  the running attempt (undefined: none)
 * @param {boolean} managed  whether the Session is managed at all
 */
export function refusal(name, attempt, managed) {
  const isTaskTool = TASK_TOOLS.includes(name)
  if (!managed) return isTaskTool ? 'Squad task tools work only in a Squad task.' : undefined
  if (attempt === undefined) return 'Squad: this Session runs only work a Controller admitted, and none is running now.'
  // An attempt the stand-in admitted (no contract) keeps the host's own tool set.
  if (attempt.allowedTools === undefined) return undefined
  if (MEMORY_WRITE.includes(name)) return 'Squad: memory is read-only during a formal task; note what you learned in your result instead.'
  return hostTools(attempt.allowedTools).has(name) ? undefined : `Squad: ${name} is not allowed in this task (allowed: ${[...hostTools(attempt.allowedTools)].join(', ')}).`
}

// File tools inside a formal attempt reach only the project directory and DS Bot's
// workspace (DSH-M1-08 "未授权路径"): an absolute path elsewhere, or a relative one
// that climbs out, is refused before the tool runs. Symlinks are followed first.

 * @param {string[]} roots  absolute directories the attempt may touch; the first is where relative paths start

 */
export function pathRefusal(name, args, roots, real = path => path) {
  const fields = PATH_ARGS[name]
  if (fields === undefined || roots.length === 0 || args === null || typeof args !== 'object') return undefined
  const inside = (target, root) => target === root || target.startsWith(root.endsWith('/') ? root : `${root}/`)

    return { attempt, binding, key, runtime: runtimeOf(binding) }
```

```text
// Shared browser helpers for the experiment judges (headless Chrome through puppeteer-core).
// puppeteer-core is not a dependency of this repository. Install it outside the repo and
// point at it:
//
//   cd ~/.cache/dsh-exp-tools && npm install puppeteer-core@25.14.0 axe-core@4.14.0
//   DSH_EXP_TOOLS=~/.cache/dsh-exp-tools CHROME=/usr/bin/google-chrome   (defaults)
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { homedir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

export const TOOLS = process.env.DSH_EXP_TOOLS ?? join(homedir(), '.cache/dsh-exp-tools')
const tools = createRequire(join(TOOLS, 'package.json'))

export async function launch() {
  const puppeteer = tools('puppeteer-core')
  return puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROME ?? '/usr/bin/google-chrome', headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--allow-file-access-from-files'] })
}

// Opens a file in a fresh page and records every request that leaves the file (R6).
// file:, data: and about: are local; anything else is recorded and aborted.
export async function openPage(browser, file, viewport = { width: 1280, height: 800 }) {
  const page = await browser.newPage()
  await page.setViewport(viewport)
  const external = []
  const errors = []
  await page.setRequestInterception(true)
  page.on('request', request => {
    const url = request.url()
    if (/^(file|data|about|blob):/.test(url)) return request.continue()
    external.push(url)
    return request.abort()
  })
  page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(message.text()) })
  page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(String(error.message ?? error)))
  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(file).href, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 15_000 })
  const hasLesson = await page.waitForFunction(() => typeof window.lesson === 'object' && window.lesson !== null, { timeout: 3000 }).then(() => true, () => false)
  return { page, external, errors, hasLesson }
}

export const frame = page => page.evaluate(() => new Promise(done => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => done()))))
export const settle = async page => { await frame(page); await new Promise(done => setTimeout(done, 30)) }

// Seeded generator, so every judge run asks the same questions.
export function seeded(seed = 20261029) {
  let state = seed >>> 0
  return () => { state = (Math.imul(state, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return state / 4294967296 }
}

// Numbers in a piece of text: handles the Unicode minus, fractions and decimals.
export function numbersIn(text) {
  const normalized = String(text ?? '').replace(/−/g, '-').replace(/,/g, '')
  const out = []
  for (const match of normalized.matchAll(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s*\/\s*\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?/g)) {
    const parts = match[0].split('/').map(part => Number(part.trim()))
    out.push(parts.length === 2 ? parts[0] / parts[1] : parts[0])
  }
  return out
}

export const near = (a, b, tol = 0.01) => Number.isFinite(a) && Number.isFinite(b) && Math.abs(a - b) <= tol

// Accessibility by axe-core: serious and critical violations of WCAG 2 A/AA.
export async function axeViolations(page) {
  await page.addScriptTag({ path: join(TOOLS, 'node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js') })
  return page.evaluate(async () => {
    const result = await window.axe.run(document, { runOnly: { type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa'] } })
    return result.violations.filter(v => v.impact === 'serious' || v.impact === 'critical').map(v => `${v.id}:${v.impact}:${v.nodes.length}`)
  })
}
```

```javascript
// The page check an author or reviewer runs on its own draft before it hands the page in
// (EXP plan §1.2, D4). A headless Chrome on the host loads the HTML with the network
// blocked and reports what a browser sees of the page itself: console errors, requests
// that would leave the page, horizontal overflow at 375 and 1280 px, the visible text,
// and controls with no accessible name. It runs no acceptance checks, so nothing the
// Run is judged on can be read from it.
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { homedir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'

// The same install the experiment judges use (puppeteer-core outside the repository).
const TOOLS = process.env.DSH_EXP_TOOLS ?? join(homedir(), '.cache/dsh-exp-tools')
const CHROME = process.env.CHROME ?? '/usr/bin/google-chrome'
const VIEWPORTS = [{ label: '375 px', width: 375, height: 812 }, { label: '1280 px', width: 1280, height: 800 }]
const MAX_HTML = 2_000_000
const MAX_TEXT = 400

// Runs in the page. Plain DOM reads only.
function measure() {
  const labelText = id => (id ? [...document.querySelectorAll(`label[for="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`)].map(el => el.textContent).join(' ') : '')
  const named = el => {
    if (el.getAttribute('aria-label')?.trim()) return true
    const ids = el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')
    if (ids && ids.split(/\s+/).some(id => document.getElementById(id)?.textContent.trim())) return true
    if (labelText(el.id).trim() || el.closest('label')) return true
    if (el.title?.trim()) return true
    if (el.tagName === 'INPUT' && el.type === 'image' && el.alt?.trim()) return true
    return el.tagName !== 'INPUT' && el.tagName !== 'SELECT' && el.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA' && el.textContent.trim() !== ''
  }
  const controls = [...document.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea, button, a[href], [role="button"], [role="slider"]')]
    .filter(el => el.type !== 'hidden' && el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && !el.closest('[hidden]'))
  const unnamed = controls.filter(el => !named(el)).map(el => (el.id ? `${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}#${el.id}` : el.tagName.toLowerCase()))
  return {
    scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
    text: (document.body?.innerText ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
    controls: controls.length,
    unnamed,
  }
}

/**
 * The page check of one HTML document, as the text the author reads back.
 * @param {string} html  the full page
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
export async function checkPage(html) {
  if (typeof html !== 'string' || html.trim() === '') return 'Page check: give the HTML of the page in html.'
  if (html.length > MAX_HTML) return `Page check: the page is over ${MAX_HTML} characters.`
  let puppeteer
  try {
    puppeteer = createRequire(join(TOOLS, 'package.json'))('puppeteer-core')
  } catch {
    return 'Page check is not available on this host (no headless browser installed).'
  }
  let browser
  try {
    browser = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: CHROME, headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
  } catch (error) {
    return `Page check failed to start the browser: ${String(error?.message ?? error).slice(0, 160)}`
  }
  try {
    const external = []
    const errors = []
    const lines = []
    let text = ''
    for (const viewport of VIEWPORTS) {
      const page = await browser.newPage()
      await page.setViewport({ width: viewport.width, height: viewport.height })
      await page.setRequestInterception(true)
      page.on('request', request => {
        if (/^(data|about|blob):/.test(request.url())) return request.continue()
        external.push(request.url().slice(0, 120))
        return request.abort()
      })
      page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(message.text().slice(0, 160)) })
      page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(String(error?.message ?? error).slice(0, 160)))
      try {
        await page.setContent(html, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 10_000 })
        const seen = await page.evaluate(measure)
        const overflow = seen.scrollWidth > viewport.width
        lines.push(`${viewport.label}: horizontal overflow ${overflow ? `yes (scrollWidth ${seen.scrollWidth})` : 'no'}`)
        if (viewport.width === VIEWPORTS[1].width) text = seen.text
        if (viewport.width === VIEWPORTS[0].width) lines.push(`controls without an accessible name: ${seen.unnamed.length === 0 ? 'none' : seen.unnamed.slice(0, 12).join(', ')} (of ${seen.controls})`)
      } catch (error) {
        lines.push(`${viewport.label}: could not render (${String(error?.message ?? error).slice(0, 120)})`)
      } finally {
        await page.close()
      }
    }
    const head = [
      `external requests (blocked): ${external.length === 0 ? 'none' : `${external.length}: ${external.slice(0, 5).join(' ')}`}`,
      `console errors: ${errors.length === 0 ? 'none' : errors.slice(0, 5).join(' | ')}`,
    ]
    return [...head, ...lines, `visible text (1280 px): ${text.slice(0, MAX_TEXT) || '(none)'}`].join('\n')
  } finally {
    await browser.close()
  }
}
```

```text
1	// dsh-squad-adapter: the DSH side of Squad. It holds managed DS Bot Sessions to what a
2	// Controller admitted, through the seam that the ds-bot patch adds (dsBotSeam), and
3	// tells the Controller what really happened (squad/3, dsh_squad/protocol):
4	//
5	// - every step of a managed Session is decided here first, before DS Bot's own pre-step
6	//   logic, whatever order the plugins loaded in (src/policy.js);
7	// - DS Bot asks before it resumes or resends work on its own, and before it reviews a
8	//   turn into memory (seam.allows);
9	// - each admitted attempt is judged done only by live and durable ends together, with
10	//   every tool call paired (src/judge.js), and only then reported settled;
11	// - a model route that differs from the frozen one is refused before the request goes
12	//   out, and again if it shows up at request time;
13	// - inside an attempt only the contract's tools and the task tools run (src/toolset.js),
14	//   and the Session sees its Role, Team and Task (src/context.js).
15	//
16	// Each managed (Bot, place) is its own Controller runtime with its own credential. Its
17	// runtime id and token live in this host's state, so a host restart keeps the identity
18	// and can report the attempts it lost (host_restart). A new part Session re-registers
19	// with the old one as previous_session_id, which moves binding_epoch on.
20	//

22	// it (manage, admit, cancel, state): the P1 drivers run on that.
```

```text
export function createClient({ endpoint, controllerId, fetch = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 10_000 }) {
  async function call(method, path, { body, runtime, operator } = {}) {
    const headers = { accept: 'application/json', 'x-squad-protocol': PROTOCOL, 'x-squad-controller': controllerId }
    if (body !== undefined) headers['content-type'] = 'application/json'
    // The operator credential stays on this host; the browser never sees it (X-3).
    if (operator !== undefined) headers.authorization = `Bearer ${operator}`
    if (runtime !== undefined) {
      headers.authorization = `Bearer ${runtime.token}`
      headers['x-squad-agent'] = runtime.binding.agent_id
      headers['x-squad-binding'] = JSON.stringify(runtime.binding)
    }
    const response = await fetch(`${endpoint}${path}`, { method, headers, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) })
    let parsed
    try { parsed = await response.json() } catch { parsed = undefined }
    if (!response.ok) throw new ControllerError(response.status, parsed)
    return parsed
  }
  return {
    call,
    health: () => call('GET', '/health'),
    register: body => call('POST', '/v2/agents/register', { body }),
    heartbeat: (runtime, activity, extra = {}) => call('POST', '/v2/agents/heartbeat', { runtime, body: { binding: runtime.binding, activity, underlying_activity: activity, ...extra } }),
    dispatches: runtime => call('GET', '/v2/dispatches', { runtime }).then(out => out?.dispatches ?? []),
    attemptEvent: (runtime, attemptId, body) => call('POST', `/v2/attempts/${encodeURIComponent(attemptId)}/events`, { runtime, body }),
    interrupt: (runtime, requestId, reason) => call('POST', '/v2/agents/interruption', { runtime, body: { request_id: requestId, binding: runtime.binding, reason } }),
    stopped: (runtime, attemptId, body) => call('POST', `/v2/attempts/${encodeURIComponent(attemptId)}/stopped`, { runtime, body }),
    hold: (runtime, input) => call('POST', '/v2/agents/held-inputs', { runtime, body: { ...input, binding: runtime.binding } }),
    task: (runtime, taskId) => call('GET', `/v2/tasks/${encodeURIComponent(taskId)}`, { runtime }),
    createChild: (runtime, parentId, body) => call('POST', `/v2/tasks/${encodeURIComponent(parentId)}/children`, { runtime, body }),
    snapshot: () => call('GET', '/v2/snapshot'),
    run: (runtime, runId) => call('GET', `/v2/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, { runtime }),
    decide: (runtime, runId, body) => call('POST', `/v2/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/decisions`, { runtime, body }),
    uploadArtifact: (runtime, body) => call('POST', '/v2/artifacts', { runtime, body }),
    clarify: (runtime, attemptId, body) => call('POST', `/v2/attempts/${encodeURIComponent(attemptId)}/clarify`, { runtime, body }),
  }
}
```

```javascript
// The artifacts a task's result carries, as the steps that read the result see them. A
// reviewer or the next step gets the page itself, not only the words of the result: without
// this, a checker could only judge a page it cannot see. Pure: the caller supplies the reader
// (controller.js artifact), so the tests need no Controller.

const TEXT = /^(text\/|application\/json|image\/svg\+xml)/
export const ARTIFACT_LIMIT = 200_000

/** The hex digest of an artifact, from the sha256 the Controller states ("sha256/<hex>" or "sha256:<hex>"). */
export const digestOf = art => String(art?.sha256 ?? '').replace(/^sha256[/:]/, '')

/**
 * The text lines that show a result's artifacts. Text and SVG are shown in full up to a
 * limit; anything else is named and left out.
 * @param {{artifacts?: {name?: string, media_type?: string, sha256?: string}[]}|undefined} result
 * @param {(hex: string) => Promise<Buffer>} read
 * @param {number} limit
 * @returns {Promise<string[]>}
 */
export async function artifactLines(result, read, limit = ARTIFACT_LIMIT) {
  const lines = []
  for (const art of result?.artifacts ?? []) {
    const name = art.name ?? 'artifact'
    const type = art.media_type ?? 'unknown'
    if (!TEXT.test(type)) {
      lines.push(`artifact ${name} (${type}): not shown`)
      continue
    }
    let text
    try {
      text = (await read(digestOf(art))).toString('utf8')
    } catch {
      lines.push(`artifact ${name}: unavailable`)
      continue
    }
    lines.push(`artifact ${name} (${type}, sha256 ${digestOf(art).slice(0, 12)}):`, text.length > limit ? `${text.slice(0, limit)}\n[cut at ${limit} characters]` : text)
  }
  return lines
}

/**
 * The HTML artifact of a result, when it has one.
 * @returns {Promise<string|undefined>}
 */
export async function htmlArtifact(result, read) {
  const art = (result?.artifacts ?? []).find(a => /html/.test(a.media_type ?? ''))
  if (art === undefined) return undefined
  return (await read(digestOf(art))).toString('utf8')
}

```

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { artifactLines, digestOf, htmlArtifact } from '../src/artifacts.js'

const store = new Map([
  ['aa'.repeat(32), Buffer.from('<!doctype html><p>page</p>')],
  ['bb'.repeat(32), Buffer.from('%PDF-1.4 binary')],
])
const read = async hex => {
  if (!store.has(hex)) throw new Error('missing')
  return store.get(hex)
}

test('the digest is read from either form the Controller states', () => {
  assert.equal(digestOf({ sha256: `sha256/${'cd'.repeat(32)}` }), 'cd'.repeat(32))
  assert.equal(digestOf({ sha256: `sha256:${'cd'.repeat(32)}` }), 'cd'.repeat(32))
})

test('a text artifact is shown to the reader; other media are named only', async () => {
  const lines = await artifactLines({
    artifacts: [
      { name: 'lesson.html', media_type: 'text/html', sha256: `sha256/${'aa'.repeat(32)}` },
      { name: 'notes.pdf', media_type: 'application/pdf', sha256: `sha256/${'bb'.repeat(32)}` },
    ],
  }, read)
  assert.equal(lines[0], `artifact lesson.html (text/html, sha256 ${'aa'.repeat(6)}):`)
  assert.equal(lines[1], '<!doctype html><p>page</p>')
  assert.equal(lines[2], 'artifact notes.pdf (application/pdf): not shown')
})

test('a long artifact is cut at the limit, and a missing one is named unavailable', async () => {
  const lines = await artifactLines({
    artifacts: [
      { name: 'lesson.html', media_type: 'text/html', sha256: `sha256/${'aa'.repeat(32)}` },
      { name: 'gone.txt', media_type: 'text/plain', sha256: `sha256/${'ee'.repeat(32)}` },
    ],
  }, read, 10)
  assert.equal(lines[1], '<!doctype ')
  assert.match(lines[1], /^<!doctype /)
  assert.equal(lines[2], '[cut at 10 characters]')
  assert.equal(lines[3], 'artifact gone.txt: unavailable')
})

test('a result without artifacts shows nothing', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(await artifactLines(undefined, read), [])
  assert.deepEqual(await artifactLines({ artifacts: [] }, read), [])
})

test('the HTML artifact of a result is found among its artifacts', async () => {
  const html = await htmlArtifact({ artifacts: [{ name: 'x.pdf', media_type: 'application/pdf', sha256: `sha256/${'bb'.repeat(32)}` }, { name: 'lesson.html', media_type: 'text/html', sha256: `sha256/${'aa'.repeat(32)}` }] }, read)
  assert.equal(html, '<!doctype html><p>page</p>')
  assert.equal(await htmlArtifact({ artifacts: [] }, read), undefined)
})
```

```text
## 7. 受控会话里的任务工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `squad_task` | 读当前任务：目标、验收、上游结果 |
| `squad_submit_result` | 提交结果（JSON 对象或文字），可附一个文件（`file_name`、`file_content`、`file_type`）；只有提交并且回合确认结束（实时 + 持久日志 + 工具配对），任务才算完成 |
| `squad_review` | 审核任务：`accepted` 或 `rejected` 加理由，自动引用被审的精确版本 |
| `squad_decide` | Leader 步骤：`dispatch`（附步骤 JSON）、`wait`、`complete` |
| `squad_yield` | 等待依赖或子任务 |
| `squad_delegate` | 把一部分交给另一个角色作为子任务；子任务没回传前父任务不能完成 |
| `squad_clarify` | 向委派方提问 |

受控会话的系统提示里有 `# Squad task` 段（角色、团队说明、任务、可用工具），其 hash 记在 Adapter 日志。

正式任务里只能用合同允许的工具（默认 `read`、`grep`、`find`、`ls`，加上面的任务工具和只读的 `recall`）；shell、`run_code`、`message_bot`、`post_to_group`、MCP 一律拒绝。文件工具只能访问项目目录、Bot 的

Leader 的 `squad_decide` 若遇到 Run 刚被改动（版本冲突），会重读 Run 再提交一次；Controller 照常校验这个决定，并为 Leader 没看到的新进展再安排一步。
```

```mjs
// Re-judges the stored final artifacts of a report with the current judge (plan §6: the
// artifacts are kept, the verdicts are judged again). The first time a report is re-judged,
// its previous version is kept next to it as <report>.judge-v<old>.json.
//
//   node dsh_squad/experiments/exp/rejudge.mjs dsh_squad/experiments/exp/reports/<report>.json
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { judgeExp01 } from './judges/exp01.mjs'

const JUDGES = { exp01: judgeExp01 }
const [file] = process.argv.slice(2)
if (!file) {
  console.error('usage: rejudge.mjs <report.json>')
  process.exit(2)
}
const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
const judge = JUDGES[report.experiment]
if (!judge) {
  console.error(`no judge for ${report.experiment}`)
  process.exit(2)
}
const artifact = report.task.artifact
const versions = new Set()
for (const record of report.runs) {
  if (record.discarded_first === true || record.final?.accepted === undefined) continue
  const path = `${record.project}/final/${artifact}`
  if (!existsSync(path)) {
    console.log(`${record.arm} ${record.repeat}: no stored artifact, left as it was`)
    continue
  }
  if (record.judge) versions.add(record.judge.version)
  const runs = []
  for (let round = 0; round < 3; round += 1) runs.push(await judge(path))
  const first = JSON.stringify(runs[0].checks.map(c => [c.id, c.ok]))
  record.judge = { ...runs[0], consistent: runs.every(r => JSON.stringify(r.checks.map(c => [c.id, c.ok])) === first) }
  delete record.judge_error
  record.goal_success = record.final.accepted === true && record.judge.must_passed === true
  console.log(`${record.arm} ${record.repeat}: goal_success=${record.goal_success} coverage=${record.judge.requirement_coverage.toFixed(3)} consistent=${record.judge.consistent}`)
}
if (versions.size > 0) {
  const kept = `${file.replace(/\.json$/, '')}.judge-v${[...versions].join('-')}.json`
  if (!existsSync(kept)) copyFileSync(file, kept)
  console.log(`previous verdicts kept in ${kept}`)
}
writeFileSync(file, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`)
console.log(`report updated: ${file}`)

```

```bash
  Chrome with the network blocked and keeps the browser sandbox (the model
  wrote the page). It takes html for a draft, or task_id of a task that
  submitted an HTML artifact. It reports console errors, requests that
  would leave the page, horizontal overflow at 375 and 1280 px, the visible
  text, and controls with no accessible name. It runs no acceptance checks.
  It is a task tool, open in every attempt, read-only.
- squad_task (src/artifacts.js): text artifacts of a task's inputs are shown
  in full (up to 200 000 characters), so a reviewer or the next step reads
  the page. Before this, a reviewer saw only the result's words.

  judged a spaced answer wrong. Ctrl+A clears the field first, so an earlier
  answer does not stay in it.
- rejudge.mjs re-judges the stored artifacts of a report with the current
  judge (plan §6) and keeps the previous verdicts beside the report.
```
