```html
      <button type="button" class="secondary" data-testid="reset">重置</button>
      <button type="button" data-testid="measure">测 10 个周期</button>
    </div>
    <p class="muted">时间 <span id="clock">0.00</span> s　摆角 <span id="now-angle">5.0</span>°</p>
    <p class="warning" data-testid="warning" id="warning" hidden>摆角较大（θ &gt; 10°），周期公式只是近似，结果会偏大。</p>
    <p data-testid="theory">理论周期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2.007 s</p>
    <svg id="pendulum" viewBox="0 0 320 240" role="img" aria-labelledby="pendulum-title">
      <title id="pendulum-title">单摆示意图</title>
      <line x1="160" y1="16" x2="160" y2="30" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="3"></line>
      <line id="rod" x1="160" y1="16" x2="260" y2="216" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"></line>
      <circle id="bob" cx="260" cy="216" r="12" fill="#1d4ed8"></circle>
    </svg>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>测量数据与图像</h2>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">摆长</th><th scope="col">10 个周期</th><th scope="col">周期</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody data-testid="table" id="table-body"></tbody>
    </table>
    <svg id="chart" data-testid="chart" viewBox="0 0 320 240" role="img" aria-labelledby="chart-title">
      <title id="chart-title">周期 T 与 √L 的关系图</title>
      <line x1="40" y1="200" x2="310" y2="200" stroke="#1f2937"></line>
      <line x1="40" y1="20" x2="40" y2="200" stroke="#1f2937"></line>
      <text x="170" y="236" font-size="12" fill="#1f2937">√L（√m）</text>
      <text x="4" y="16" font-size="12" fill="#1f2937">T（s）</text>
      <line id="fit" x1="40" y1="200" x2="40" y2="200" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2"></line>
      <g id="points"></g>
    </svg>
    <p><span class="feedback" data-testid="slope" id="slope">拟合斜率 k 尚未得出（至少需要一组测量）</span></p>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>小测</h2>
    <div class="quiz-item">
      <p id="quiz-1-q">1. L = 0.25 m 时单摆的周期 T 为多少秒（保留 2 位小数）？</p>
      <div class="quiz-row">
        <label for="quiz-1-input">答案（s）</label>
        <input id="quiz-1-input" data-testid="quiz-1-input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off">
        <button type="button" data-testid="quiz-1-submit">提交</button>
      </div>
      <p class="feedback" data-testid="quiz-1-feedback" data-result="wrong" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-item">
      <p id="quiz-2-q">2. L = 1.00 m 时单摆的周期 T 为多少秒（保留 2 位小数）？</p>
      <div class="quiz-row">
        <label for="quiz-2-input">答案（s）</label>
        <input id="quiz-2-input" data-testid="quiz-2-input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off">
        <button type="button" data-testid="quiz-2-submit">提交</button>
      </div>
      <p class="feedback" data-testid="quiz-2-feedback" data-result="wrong" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-item">
      <p id="quiz-3-q">3. 摆长变为原来的 4 倍，周期变为原来的几倍？</p>
      <div class="quiz-row">
        <label for="quiz-3-input">答案（倍）</label>
        <input id="quiz-3-input" data-testid="quiz-3-input" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off">
        <button type="button" data-testid="quiz-3-submit">提交</button>
      </div>
      <p class="feedback" data-testid="quiz-3-feedback" data-result="wrong" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
(function () {
  var G = 9.8;
  var STEP = 1 / 240;
  var SAMPLE_EVERY = 2;
  var MAX_SERIES = 6000;
  var state = { L: 1, theta0: 5 * Math.PI / 180, theta: 5 * Math.PI / 180, omega: 0, t: 0, running: false, steps: 0, series: [], ups: null, measureRows: [] };
  var acc = 0;
  var last = null;
  var prevAngle = state.theta0;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var lengthInput = $('length');
  var angleInput = $('angle');
  var rod = $('rod');
  var bob = $('bob');
  var PIVOT = { x: 160, y: 16 };
  var PX_PER_M = 100;

  function deg(rad) { return rad * 180 / Math.PI; }
  function theory(L) { return 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / G); }

  function accel(theta) { return -(G / state.L) * Math.sin(theta); }

  function sample(prev, next) {
    state.series.push({ t: state.t, angleDeg: deg(next) });
    if (state.series.length > MAX_SERIES) state.series.splice(0, state.series.length - MAX_SERIES);
    if (state.ups !== null && prev < 0 && next >= 0) {
      state.ups.push(state.t);
    }
  }

  function step(h) {
    var th = state.theta, w = state.omega;
    var k1t = w, k1w = accel(th);
    var k2t = w + h / 2 * k1w, k2w = accel(th + h / 2 * k1t);
    var k3t = w + h / 2 * k2w, k3w = accel(th + h / 2 * k2t);
    var k4t = w + h * k3w, k4w = accel(th + h * k3t);
    var prev = th;
    state.theta = th + h / 6 * (k1t + 2 * k2t + 2 * k3t + k4t);
    state.omega = w + h / 6 * (k1w + 2 * k2w + 2 * k3w + k4w);
    state.t += h;
    state.steps += 1;
    if (state.steps % SAMPLE_EVERY === 0) sample(prev, state.theta);
    if (state.ups !== null && state.ups.length >= 11 && state.measuring) finishMeasure();
  }

  function reset() {
    state.theta = state.theta0;
    state.omega = 0;
    state.t = 0;
    state.steps = 0;
    state.series = [];
    state.ups = null;
    state.measuring = false;
    acc = 0;
    prevAngle = state.theta0;
  }

  function setLength(v) {
    state.L = Number(v);
    $('length-value').textContent = state.L.toFixed(2);
    $('theory').textContent = 'theory';
    updateTheory();
  }

  function updateTheory() {
    var T = theory(state.L);
    document.querySelector('[data-testid="theory"]').textContent = '理论周期 T = 2π√(L/g) = ' + T.toFixed(3) + ' s（L = ' + state.L.toFixed(2) + ' m）';
  }

  function setAngle(v) {
    state.theta0 = Number(v) * Math.PI / 180;
    $('angle-value').textContent = String(Number(v));
    $('warning').hidden = !(Number(v) > 10);
  }

  function draw() {
    var x = PIVOT.x + state.L * PX_PER_M * Math.sin(state.theta);
    var y = PIVOT.y + state.L * PX_PER_M * Math.cos(state.theta);
    rod.setAttribute('x2', x.toFixed(2));
    rod.setAttribute('y2', y.toFixed(2));
    bob.setAttribute('cx', x.toFixed(2));
    bob.setAttribute('cy', y.toFixed(2));
    $('clock').textContent = state.t.toFixed(2);
    $('now-angle').textContent = deg(state.theta).toFixed(1);
  }

  function frame(now) {
    if (last === null) last = now;
    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (state.running) {
      acc += dt;
      while (acc >= STEP) { step(STEP); acc -= STEP; }
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function start() { state.running = true; }
  function pause() { state.running = false; }

  // Measure: from the first upward crossing, the time of ten full periods (11 crossings).
  function measure() {
    reset();
    state.ups = [];
    state.measuring = true;
    state.running = true;
  }

  function finishMeasure() {
    state.measuring = false;
    state.running = false;
    var tenT = state.ups[10] - state.ups[0];
    var T = tenT / 10;
    var L = state.L;
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.setAttribute('data-testid', 'row');
    tr.innerHTML = '<td>L = ' + L.toFixed(2) + ' m</td><td>10T = ' + tenT.toFixed(2) + ' s</td><td>T = ' + T.toFixed(3) + ' s</td>';
    $('table-body').appendChild(tr);
    state.measureRows.push({ L: L, T: T });
    drawChart();
  }

  function drawChart() {
    var rows = state.measureRows;
    var g = $('points');
    g.innerHTML = '';
    var xmax = 1.5, ymax = 3;
    var X = function (sqrtL) { return 40 + sqrtL / xmax * 260; };
    var Y = function (T) { return 200 - T / ymax * 180; };
    var num = 0, den = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var x = Math.sqrt(r.L);
      num += x * r.T;
      den += x * x;
      var c = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
      c.setAttribute('data-testid', 'point');
      c.setAttribute('cx', X(x).toFixed(2));
      c.setAttribute('cy', Y(r.T).toFixed(2));
      c.setAttribute('r', '4');
      c.setAttribute('fill', '#1d4ed8');
      g.appendChild(c);
    });
    if (den > 0) {
      var k = num / den;
      var fit = $('fit');
      fit.setAttribute('x2', X(xmax).toFixed(2));
      fit.setAttribute('y2', Y(k * xmax).toFixed(2));
      $('slope').textContent = '拟合斜率 k = ' + k.toFixed(3) + ' s/√m（理论值 2π/√g ≈ ' + (2 * Math.PI / Math.sqrt(G)).toFixed(3) + '）';
    }
  }

  // Upward zero crossings of a series, linearly interpolated.
  window.lessonState = function () {
    return {
      running: state.running,
      t: state.t,
      lengthM: state.L,
      theta0Deg: deg(state.theta0),
      angleDeg: deg(state.theta),
      series: state.series.slice(-6000),
    };
  };

  function answer(id, expected, tolerance) {
    var input = $('quiz-' + id + '-input');
    var out = document.querySelector('[data-testid="quiz-' + id + '-feedback"]');
    var raw = String(input.value).trim().replace(',', '.');
    var value = raw === '' ? NaN : Number(raw);
    var ok = Number.isFinite(value) && Math.abs(value - expected) <= tolerance + 1e-9;
    out.setAttribute('data-result', ok ? 'correct' : 'wrong');
    out.textContent = ok ? '正确。' : '不正确，请再检查计算。';
  }

  lengthInput.addEventListener('input', function () { setLength(lengthInput.value); reset(); });
  angleInput.addEventListener('input', function () { setAngle(angleInput.value); reset(); });
  $('start').addEventListener('click', start);
  $('pause').addEventListener('click', pause);
  $('reset').addEventListener('click', function () { reset(); state.running = false; });
  $('measure').addEventListener('click', measure);
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="quiz-"][id$="-input"]').forEach(function (el) { el.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') e.target.nextElementSibling.click(); }); });
  $('quiz-1-submit').addEventListener('click', function () { answer(1, 1.00, 0.01); });
  $('quiz-2-submit').addEventListener('click', function () { answer(2, 2.01, 0.01); });
  $('quiz-3-submit').addEventListener('click', function () { answer(3, 2, 0.01); });

  setLength(lengthInput.value);
  setAngle(angleInput.value);
  reset();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```mjs
// EXP-02 judge: deterministic checks of the pendulum page (lesson.html) against R1–R10 and
// the interface the task gives every arm (window.lessonState, specs/exp02.json). Nothing
// here is an LLM. Each check says what it tried and why it failed. The timing checks run in
// real time: a full judge round takes a few minutes.
//
//   node dsh_squad/experiments/exp/judges/exp02.mjs <lesson.html>      (prints JSON)
import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { axeViolations, launch, near, numbersIn, settle } from './browser.mjs'

const G = 9.8
const LENGTHS = [0.25, 1.0, 1.96]
const MOBILE = { width: 375, height: 812 }
const DESKTOP = { width: 1280, height: 800 }
const sleep = ms => new Promise(done => setTimeout(done, ms))
const theory = L => 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L / G)

// Opens the page and records outside requests and console errors. Ready = window.lessonState exists.
async function openPage(browser, file, viewport) {
  const page = await browser.newPage()
  await page.setViewport(viewport)
  const external = []
  const errors = []
  await page.setRequestInterception(true)
  page.on('request', request => {
    const url = request.url()
    if (/^(file|data|about|blob):/.test(url)) return request.continue()
    external.push(url)
    return request.abort()
  })
  page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(message.text()) })
  page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(String(error.message ?? error)))
  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(file).href, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 15_000 })
  const hasState = await page.waitForFunction(() => typeof window.lessonState === 'function', { timeout: 3000 }).then(() => true, () => false)
  return { page, external, errors, hasState }
}

const state = page => page.evaluate(() => window.lessonState())
const text = (page, id) => page.evaluate(testid => document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${testid}"]`)?.textContent ?? '', id)
const click = (page, id) => page.click(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)

// Sets a range input the way a slider's events do, then lets the page redraw.
async function slide(page, id, value) {
  await page.evaluate((testid, v) => {
    const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${testid}"]`)
    el.value = String(v)
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))
  }, id, value)
  await settle(page)
}

// Clears a field and types the value by keystrokes (a number field drops what it may not hold).
async function typeInto(page, id, value) {
  await page.click(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)
  await page.keyboard.down('Control')
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyA')
  await page.keyboard.up('Control')
  await page.keyboard.press('Backspace')
  if (value !== '') await page.keyboard.type(value)
}

// Upward zero crossings of the angle series, linearly interpolated.
function crossings(series) {
  const out = []
  for (let i = 1; i < series.length; i += 1) {
    const a = series[i - 1]
    const b = series[i]
    if (a.angleDeg < 0 && b.angleDeg >= 0) out.push(a.t + (0 - a.angleDeg) * (b.t - a.t) / (b.angleDeg - a.angleDeg))
  }
  return out
}

const fail = detail => ({ ok: false, detail })
const pass = () => ({ ok: true })
const joined = bad => (bad.length === 0 ? pass() : fail(bad.slice(0, 4).join('; ') + (bad.length > 4 ? ` (+${bad.length - 4})` : '')))

// R1: goal and principle text, and the theory line follows the length.
async function principle(page) {
  const bad = []
  if ((await text(page, 'goal')).trim().length < 4) bad.push('no goal text')
  const statement = await text(page, 'principle')
  if (!/2\s*π/.test(statement) || !statement.includes('√')) bad.push('principle does not state T = 2π√(L/g)')
  if (!/10\s*°/.test(statement)) bad.push('principle does not state the 10° limit')
  for (const L of [1.96, 0.25]) {
    await slide(page, 'length', L)
    if (!numbersIn(await text(page, 'theory')).some(v => near(v, theory(L), 0.0015))) bad.push(`theory does not show ${theory(L).toFixed(3)} s for L = ${L}`)
  }
  await slide(page, 'length', 1)
  return joined(bad)
}

// R2: start, pause (the clock holds, the angle holds), resume (no jump), reset, and a change of length restarts.
async function stateMachine(page) {
  const bad = []
  await slide(page, 'length', 1)
  await slide(page, 'angle', 5)
  await click(page, 'reset')
  await sleep(100)
  let s = await state(page)
  if (s.running || s.t > 0.01) bad.push('reset does not stop and zero the clock')
  await click(page, 'start')
  await sleep(1000)
  s = await state(page)
  if (!s.running || s.t < 0.5) bad.push('start does not run the motion')
  await click(page, 'pause')
  await sleep(150)
  const paused = await state(page)
  await sleep(600)
  const held = await state(page)
  if (held.running || Math.abs(held.t - paused.t) > 0.01 || Math.abs(held.angleDeg - paused.angleDeg) > 0.01) bad.push('pause does not hold the clock and the angle')
  await click(page, 'start')
  await sleep(300)
  const resumed = await state(page)
  const before = paused.series.at(-1)
  const after = resumed.series.find(p => p.t > paused.t)
  if (!before || !after || after.t - before.t > 0.1 || Math.abs(after.angleDeg - before.angleDeg) > 2) bad.push('resume does not continue the motion smoothly')
  await click(page, 'reset')
  await sleep(100)
  s = await state(page)
  if (s.running || s.t > 0.01 || Math.abs(s.angleDeg - 5) > 0.05) bad.push('reset does not return to the starting angle')
  await click(page, 'start')
  await sleep(400)
  await slide(page, 'length', 0.5)
  await sleep(60)
  s = await state(page)
  if (s.t > 0.2) bad.push('changing the length while running does not restart the motion')
  await click(page, 'reset')
  return joined(bad)
}

// R3: the period from the series, for three lengths at a 5° start, within 3% of 2π√(L/g).
async function periods(page) {
  const bad = []
  for (const L of LENGTHS) {
    await slide(page, 'length', L)
    await slide(page, 'angle', 5)
    await click(page, 'reset')
    await click(page, 'start')
    const want = 4 * theory(L) + 0.5
    let s = await state(page)
    for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !(s.series.length > 0 && s.series.at(-1).t >= want); i += 1) {
      await sleep(200)
      s = await state(page)
    }
    await click(page, 'pause')
    const ups = crossings(s.series)
    if (ups.length < 3) {
      bad.push(`L = ${L}: fewer than 3 periods in the series`)
      continue
    }
    const gaps = ups.slice(1).map((t, i) => t - ups[i])
    const T = gaps.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g, 0) / gaps.length
    const err = Math.abs(T - theory(L)) / theory(L)
    if (err >= 0.03) bad.push(`L = ${L}: period ${T.toFixed(3)} s against ${theory(L).toFixed(3)} s (${(err * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`)
  }
  return joined(bad)
}

// Waits for a measurement row beyond the first `before` rows; returns its cell texts.
async function waitRow(page, before) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 180; i += 1) {
    const cells = await page.evaluate(n => {
      const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="row"]')
      if (rows.length <= n) return null
      return [...rows[rows.length - 1].querySelectorAll('td')].map(td => td.textContent)
    }, before)
    if (cells) return cells
    await sleep(500)
  }
  return null
}

// R4: the 10-period measurement for each length, as a row of three values.
async function measures(page) {
  const bad = []
  for (const L of LENGTHS) {
    await slide(page, 'length', L)
    const before = await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="row"]').length)
    await click(page, 'measure')
    const cells = await waitRow(page, before)
    if (!cells || cells.length < 3) {
      bad.push(`L = ${L}: no measurement row within 90 s`)
      continue
    }
    const [rowL, tenT, T] = cells.map(cell => {
      const m = /=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/.exec(cell)
      return m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN
    })
    if (!near(rowL, L, 0.005)) bad.push(`row says L = ${rowL} for ${L}`)
    if (Math.abs(tenT - 10 * theory(L)) / (10 * theory(L)) >= 0.03) bad.push(`L = ${L}: 10T = ${tenT} s against ${(10 * theory(L)).toFixed(2)} s`)
    if (!near(tenT / 10, T, 0.01)) bad.push(`L = ${L}: T ${T} does not match 10T / 10`)
  }
  return joined(bad)
}

// R5: one point per measurement, and the slope within 5% of 2π/√g.
async function chart(page) {
  const rows = await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="row"]').length)
  const points = await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="point"]').length)
  if (rows < 3 || points !== rows) return fail(`${points} points for ${rows} rows`)
  const k = numbersIn(await text(page, 'slope'))[0]
  const want = 2 * Math.PI / Math.sqrt(G)
  return Number.isFinite(k) && Math.abs(k - want) / want <= 0.05 ? pass() : fail(`slope ${k} against ${want.toFixed(3)}`)
}

// R6: at 25° the warning shows and says it is approximate.
async function warning(page) {
  await slide(page, 'angle', 25)
  const shown = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="warning"]')
    return Boolean(el) && !el.hidden && el.textContent.includes('近似')
  })
  await slide(page, 'angle', 5)
  return shown ? pass() : fail('no warning containing 近似 at 25°')
}

// R7: three numeric questions: a right answer, a wrong one and a non-number, each with text feedback.
async function quizzes(page) {
  const answers = { 1: ['1.00', '2.00'], 2: ['2.01', '1.00'], 3: ['2', '3'] }
  const bad = []
  for (const [n, [right, wrong]] of Object.entries(answers)) {
    for (const [value, want] of [[right, 'correct'], [wrong, 'wrong'], ['abc', 'wrong']]) {
      await typeInto(page, `quiz-${n}-input`, value)
      await click(page, `quiz-${n}-submit`)
      await settle(page)
      const feedback = await page.evaluate(id => {
        const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)
        return { result: el?.getAttribute('data-result') ?? 'none', text: el?.textContent.trim() ?? '' }
      }, `quiz-${n}-feedback`)
      if (feedback.result !== want) bad.push(`quiz ${n} with "${value}": got ${feedback.result}, want ${want}`)
      if (feedback.text === '') bad.push(`quiz ${n} with "${value}": no feedback text`)
    }
  }
  return joined(bad)
}

// R10: names and keyboard reach for each control, and axe on the page.
async function accessibility(page) {
  const controls = ['length', 'angle', 'start', 'pause', 'reset', 'measure', 'quiz-1-input', 'quiz-1-submit', 'quiz-2-input', 'quiz-2-submit', 'quiz-3-input', 'quiz-3-submit']
  const unfocusable = await page.evaluate(ids => ids.filter(id => {
    const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)
    if (!el) return true
    el.focus()
    return document.activeElement !== el
  }), controls)
  const unnamed = await page.evaluate(ids => ids.filter(id => {
    const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)
    if (!el) return true
    const named = el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') || (el.id && document.querySelector(`label[for="${el.id}"]`)) || el.closest('label') || el.textContent.trim()
    return !named
  }), controls)
  const violations = await axeViolations(page)
  const problems = [...unfocusable.map(id => `not focusable ${id}`), ...unnamed.map(id => `no accessible name ${id}`), ...violations.map(v => `axe ${v}`)]
  return problems.length === 0 ? pass() : fail(problems.slice(0, 6).join('; '))
}

// R9: 375 px, no horizontal scroll, the controls inside the viewport.
async function mobileLayout(browser, file) {
  const { page, external, errors } = await openPage(browser, file, MOBILE)
  const width = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth)
  const outside = await page.evaluate(ids => ids.filter(id => {
    const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)
    if (!el) return true
    const box = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    return box.left < 0 || box.right > window.innerWidth + 0.5 || box.width === 0
  }), ['length', 'angle', 'start', 'pause', 'reset', 'measure', 'quiz-1-submit', 'quiz-3-submit'])
  await page.close()
  return { width, outside, external: external.length, errors: errors.length }
}

// A check that throws fails that check with the reason; it does not stop the others.
export async function judgeExp02(file) {
  const browser = await launch()
  const checks = []
  const add = (id, level, result) => checks.push({ id, level, ok: result.ok, detail: result.detail ?? null })
  const guard = async (id, level, body) => {
    try {
      add(id, level, await body())
    } catch (error) {
      add(id, level, fail(`exception: ${String(error.message ?? error).slice(0, 160)}`))
    }
  }
  try {
    const { page, external, errors, hasState } = await openPage(browser, file, DESKTOP)
    add('C0', 'must', hasState ? pass() : fail('window.lessonState is not a function'))
    if (hasState) {
      await guard('R1', 'must', () => principle(page))
      await guard('R2', 'must', () => stateMachine(page))
      await guard('R3', 'must', () => periods(page))
      await guard('R4', 'must', () => measures(page))
      await guard('R5', 'must', () => chart(page))
      await guard('R6', 'should', () => warning(page))
      await guard('R7', 'must', () => quizzes(page))
      await guard('R10', 'should', () => accessibility(page))
    }
    await page.close()
    let mobile = { width: 0, outside: [], external: 0, errors: 0 }
    await guard('R9', 'should', async () => {
      mobile = await mobileLayout(browser, file)
      return mobile.width <= MOBILE.width && mobile.outside.length === 0 ? pass() : fail(`scrollWidth ${mobile.width}; outside: ${mobile.outside.join(',') || 'none'}`)
    })
    const extEnd = external.length + mobile.external
    add('R8', 'must', extEnd === 0 ? pass() : fail(`${extEnd} external request(s)`))
    const errs = errors.length + mobile.errors
    add('C1', 'must', errs === 0 ? pass() : fail(errors.slice(0, 2).join(' | ')))
  } catch (error) {
    add('C0', 'must', fail(`exception: ${String(error.message ?? error).slice(0, 160)}`))
  } finally {
    await browser.close()
  }
  const must = checks.filter(c => c.level === 'must')
  const requirements = checks.filter(c => c.id.startsWith('R'))
  return {
    judge: 'exp02',
    version: 1,
    checks,
    must_passed: must.every(c => c.ok),
    requirement_coverage: requirements.filter(c => c.ok).length / requirements.length,
    goal_success: must.every(c => c.ok),
  }
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const file = process.argv[2]
  if (!file) {
    console.error('usage: exp02.mjs <lesson.html>')
    process.exit(2)
  }
  console.log(JSON.stringify(await judgeExp02(file), null, 2))
}
```

_**Agent (claude-haiku-5-5 2026-10-29 05:43:46-0700)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```mjs
// Markdown summary of an experiment report (plan §1.5, §1.6): every run, then per arm the
// count of successes, the median and range of requirement coverage, and the median time.
// It states no p-values: with these sample sizes a difference is only written when the arms'
// ranges do not overlap (plan §1.5).
//
//   node dsh_squad/experiments/exp/summarize.mjs <report.json> [> summary.md]
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const [file] = process.argv.slice(2)
if (!file) {
  console.error('usage: summarize.mjs <report.json>')
  process.exit(2)
}
const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
const runs = report.runs.filter(r => r.discarded_first !== true)
const discarded = report.runs.length - runs.length

const median = xs => {
  if (xs.length === 0) return null
  const s = [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b)
  const mid = Math.floor(s.length / 2)
  return s.length % 2 ? s[mid] : (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
}
const range = xs => (xs.length === 0 ? null : [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs)])
const pct = x => (x === null ? '-' : `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`)
const fmt = x => (x === null ? '-' : x.toFixed(2))
const failedChecks = run => (run.judge?.checks ?? []).filter(c => !c.ok).map(c => c.id).join(' ')

const lines = []
lines.push(`# ${report.title}`, '')
lines.push(`- 报告：\`${report.id}\``)
lines.push(`- 模式：${report.mock ? '**mock，只验证流程，数字不代表真实效果**' : `真实运行，${report.model.provider} / ${report.model.model}，effort ${report.model.effort}`}`)
lines.push(`- 每组重复：${report.repeats} 次；环境中断后重跑的记录：${discarded} 条（已从下表排除，报告 JSON 中保留）`)
lines.push('')
lines.push('## 每次运行')
lines.push('')
lines.push('| arm | 轮次 | 序号 | 结果 | 用时（s） | 验收 | 必过检查 | 覆盖率 | 未通过的检查 | 判题版本 |')
lines.push('|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|')
for (const run of runs) {
  const j = run.judge
  lines.push(`| ${run.arm} | ${run.repeat} | ${run.order ?? '-'} | ${run.outcome} | ${fmt(run.seconds)} | ${run.final?.accepted ? '是' : '否'} | ${j ? (j.must_passed ? '是' : '否') : '-'} | ${j ? pct(j.requirement_coverage) : '-'} | ${failedChecks(run) || '-'} | ${j?.version ?? '-'} |`)
}
lines.push('')
lines.push('## 每组汇总')
lines.push('')
lines.push('| arm | Goal Success | 覆盖率 中位数 | 覆盖率 范围 | 用时 中位数（s） | 用时 范围（s） |')
lines.push('|---|---|---|---|---|---|')
for (const arm of report.arms) {
  const mine = runs.filter(r => r.arm === arm)
  const ok = mine.filter(r => r.goal_success === true).length
  const coverage = mine.map(r => r.judge?.requirement_coverage).filter(x => typeof x === 'number')
  const seconds = mine.map(r => r.seconds).filter(x => typeof x === 'number')
  const r = range(coverage)
  const sr = range(seconds)
  lines.push(`| ${arm} | ${ok}/${mine.length} | ${pct(median(coverage))} | ${r ? `${pct(r[0])}～${pct(r[1])}` : '-'} | ${fmt(median(seconds))} | ${sr ? `${fmt(sr[0])}～${fmt(sr[1])}` : '-'} |`)
}
lines.push('')
lines.push('完整的运行明细、判题检查和失败归因在报告 JSON 中。样本小，不报显著性；只有两组范围不重叠时才写「优于」。')
console.log(lines.join('\n'))

```

P1 的状态暴露出一个控制器缺陷，不是模型的问题：

- 设计稿第一版被审核退回，系统生成了返工；返工后的设计稿已经通过审核。

_**Agent (claude-haiku-5-5 2026-10-29 05:58:01-0700)**_

根因找到了：`acceptance_accepted` 的依赖只看**被依赖的那个任务本身**的验收状态。被退回的原始设计稿永远是 `rejected`，返工接受以后，依赖它的 `builder` 也不会被放行。这同时也会让 `builder` 读到被退回的旧设计稿，而不是通过的那一版。修复方案：在返工被接受、旧任务被标记为 `SupersededBy` 的同时，把**尚未开始**（`planned`）的依赖者改指向返工任务。

这个改动在 controller 里，必须先停掉正在跑的运行。我先停掉运行器，清理 P1 第 1 轮的 controller 和宿主，保留已经完成的 B0、B1 记录。

```text
// drive answers every dispatch until nothing moves; person is called with the Run's
// stale tasks each round and may act on them.
func (h *harness) drive(runID string, person func(stale []task.Contract, gate []string) bool) (gateCodes []string) {
	reviews := 0
	for round := 0; round < 60; round++ {
		h.tick()
		moved := false
		for _, id := range []string{"chief", "math-builder", "math-reviewer", "math-checker"} {
			p := h.principal(id)
			out, err := h.svc.Dispatches(h.ctx, p)
			if err != nil || len(out) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			a := out[0]["attempt"].(task.Attempt)
			c := out[0]["task"].(task.Contract)
			if a.State != "admitted" {
				continue
			}
			for _, step := range []string{"adapter_received", "injection_requested", "input_observed"} {
				a = h.must(h.event(p, a, AttemptEvent{Type: step}))
			}
			switch c.Kind {
			case "leader_step":
				run := h.runOf(runID)
				action, steps := "wait", []project.Step(nil)
				if rejected := h.rejectedWithoutRework(runID); rejected != "" {
					action, steps = "dispatch", []project.Step{{ID: "rework-1", RoleRef: "builder", Kind: "rework", ReworkOf: rejected, Goal: "fix", DependsOn: []project.Dependency{}}}
				} else if planned := h.planOf(runID); len(planned) > 0 {
					action, steps = "dispatch", planned
				} else if h.allAccepted(runID) {
					action = "complete"
				}
				_, err := h.svc.Decide(h.ctx, p, runID, Decision{RequestID: "d-" + a.ID[:16], ExpectedRevision: run.Revision, AttemptID: a.ID, Action: action, Tasks: steps, Note: action})
				if e, ok := err.(*task.Error); ok {
					gateCodes = append(gateCodes, e.Code)
				}
				a, _ = h.attemptOf(a.ID)
				if a.State != "result_proposed" {
					// A refused complete: the Leader waits instead.
					_, _ = h.svc.Decide(h.ctx, p, runID, Decision{RequestID: "w-" + a.ID[:16], ExpectedRevision: h.runOf(runID).Revision, AttemptID: a.ID, Action: "wait", Note: "wait"})
```
